function hubText(){const t=HUB_TXT[LANG];document.querySelectorAll('[data-hub]').forEach(el=>{const k=el.dataset.hub;if(t[k])el.textContent=t[k];});$('#vsBack').textContent=t.back;if(curView)vsTitle.textContent=VIEW_TITLES[curView][LANG];const ht=document.getElementById('hubToggle');if(ht){const open=ht.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true';ht.setAttribute('aria-label',LANG==='es'?(open?'Contraer la sección ¿Qué necesitas?':'Expandir la sección ¿Qué necesitas?'):(open?'Collapse What do you need? section':'Expand What do you need? section'));}}
function initRevShow(){const track=document.getElementById('revSlides');if(!track||!track.children.length)return;const N=REVIEWS.length,dots=[...document.querySelectorAll('.rev-dot')],count=document.getElementById('revCount');
  /* seamless infinite loop: clone of last slide in front, clone of first at the end; snap back without animation after passing a clone */
  const firstC=track.children[0].cloneNode(true),lastC=track.children[track.children.length-1].cloneNode(true);
  firstC.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');lastC.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  track.appendChild(firstC);track.insertBefore(lastC,track.children[0]);
  let pos=1,anim=false;
  function render(){track.style.transition=anim?'transform .45s ease':'none';track.style.transform=`translateX(-${pos*100}%)`;const ri=(pos-1+N)%N;dots.forEach((d,j)=>d.classList.toggle('on',j===ri));if(count)count.textContent=(ri+1)+' / '+N;}
  function snap(){if(pos===0){pos=N;anim=false;render();}else if(pos===N+1){pos=1;anim=false;render();}}
  function go(d){if(pos===0||pos===N+1)return;pos+=d;anim=true;render();setTimeout(snap,480);}
  track.addEventListener('transitionend',snap);
  const pv=document.getElementById('revPrev'),nx=document.getElementById('revNext');
  if(pv)pv.addEventListener('click',()=>go(-1));if(nx)nx.addEventListener('click',()=>go(1));
  dots.forEach(d=>d.addEventListener('click',()=>{pos=+d.dataset.rev+1;anim=true;render();}));
  const vp=document.getElementById('revViewport');let tx=null;
  vp.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{tx=e.touches[0].clientX;},{passive:true});
  vp.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{if(tx===null)return;const dx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-tx;if(Math.abs(dx)>42)go(dx<0?1:-1);tx=null;},{passive:true});
  render();}
/* Our Story videos — inline only (Taylor's order): the facade button is
   the only play target; on tap it is replaced in place by the official
   embed (YouTube youtube-nocookie with playsinline, Vimeo player) with
   autoplay, so the video plays inside the Our Story view. Nothing in
   the play path links or navigates to youtube.com / vimeo.com. */
function initStoryVideos(){
  vsBody.querySelectorAll('[data-vid]').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
      var fr=btn.parentElement;if(!fr)return;
      var yt=btn.dataset.vid==='yt';
      var src=yt?'https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Y2OwQ58hF78?autoplay=1&playsinline=1&rel=0'
                :'https://player.vimeo.com/video/1059305041?h=9bbba72a79&autoplay=1&playsinline=1';
      var title=yt?'PRODUCED BY PREMIERE | Yoox + Net-A-Porter Holiday Social — Premiere Vibes Media'
                  :'Dissident Dialogues 2024 — Premiere Vibes';
      fr.innerHTML='<iframe src="'+src+'" title="'+title+'" allow="autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture; encrypted-media" allowfullscreen referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"></iframe>';
    });
  });
}
function openView(id){if(!VIEW_TITLES[id])return;var wasOpen=viewSheet.classList.contains('open');curView=id;vsTitle.textContent=VIEW_TITLES[id][LANG];vsBody.innerHTML=viewBodyHTML(id);viewSheet.classList.add('open');viewSheet.classList.toggle('is-story',id==='story');viewSheet.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');viewSheet.scrollTop=0;if(!wasOpen)lockScroll();
  vsBody.querySelectorAll('[data-call]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',callSheet));
  initRevShow();
  initStoryVideos();
  if(window.__wireMom)window.__wireMom();
  wireBook();
  vsBody.querySelectorAll('[data-goview]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>openView(b.dataset.goview)));}
function closeView(){if(!viewSheet.classList.contains('open'))return;curView=null;viewSheet.classList.remove('open');viewSheet.classList.remove('is-story');viewSheet.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');unlockScroll();}
$('#vsBack').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(window.__momBack&&window.__momBack())return;closeView();});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(b.dataset.view==='moments')window.__momStageOnly=false;openView(b.dataset.view);}));
/* hamburger menu destinations — wired here, in the same block as openView
   itself, with the same plain direct-listener pattern as the [data-view]
   hub buttons above: close the menu, then open the view. */
document.querySelectorAll('.mp-links [data-mnav]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{closeMenu();window.scrollTo({top:0});openView(b.dataset.mnav);}));
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const a=e.target.closest('a[href^="#"]');if(!a)return;const id=a.getAttribute('href').slice(1);if(VIEW_TITLES[id]){e.preventDefault();closeMenu();window.scrollTo({top:0});openView(id);}});
hubText();
/* hub collapse — heading button toggles the whole hub body; collapsed by default */
(function(){
  var sec=document.getElementById('hub'),tog=document.getElementById('hubToggle'),bod=document.getElementById('hubBody');
  if(!sec||!tog||!bod)return;
  function setHub(open){
    sec.classList.toggle('is-open',open);
    sec.classList.toggle('hub-collapsed',!open);
    tog.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open?'true':'false');
    bod.hidden=!open;
    tog.setAttribute('aria-label',LANG==='es'?(open?'Contraer la sección ¿Qué necesitas?':'Expandir la sección ¿Qué necesitas?'):(open?'Collapse What do you need? section':'Expand What do you need? section'));
  }
  tog.addEventListener('click',function(){setHub(tog.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true');});
  setHub(false);
  window.__setHub=setHub;
})();
const _setLang=setLang; setLang=function(l){_setLang(l);hubText();if(curView)vsBody.innerHTML=viewBodyHTML(curView),vsBody.querySelectorAll('[data-call]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',callSheet)),vsBody.querySelectorAll('[data-goview]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>openView(b.dataset.goview))),initRevShow(),wireBook();renderPills();};
/* --- toast --- */
function toast(msg){const t=$('#toast');t.textContent=msg;t.style.display='block';clearTimeout(t._h);t._h=setTimeout(()=>t.style.display='none',4200);}
/* --- session leads from the public form --- */
const LEADS=[];
document.addEventListener('submit',e=>{
  if(e.target.id!=='bookForm')return;
  if(e.target.dataset.bk==='v2')return; /* v2 booking form is handled by wireBook */
  const f=new FormData(e.target);
  LEADS.unshift({name:(f.get('first')+' '+f.get('last')).trim(),type:f.get('subject'),msg:f.get('message'),when:new Date().toLocaleTimeString([],{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'})});
  renderPills();
  toast(LANG==='es'?'Consulta abierta en tu correo y guardada en el Panel del Propietario → Consultas nuevas (esta sesión).':'Inquiry opened in your email app + saved to Owner Dashboard → New Inquiries (this session).');
});
/* --- owner dashboard entry (inside hamburger) — DEMO PREVIEW ---
   Static / GitHub Pages build: there is no server here to check a
   password against, so no credential gate ships in this version.
   Owner Log In opens the collapsed Owner Dashboard directly, and the
   dashboard itself carries a visible DEMO PREVIEW label — everything
   inside it is the dashboard's labeled demo/sample content. A real
   owner login would need a separate server-backed version. */
$('#loginBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  closeMenu();
  openDash();
});
/* --- dashboard --- */
const dash=$('#dash'),detail=$('#dashDetail');
function openDash(){var wasOpen=dash.classList.contains('open');dash.classList.add('open');if(!wasOpen)lockScroll();/* AUTO-REFRESH FIX, phase 2: mark the dashboard in the URL hash. The dashboard is an in-page view, so any browser-level reload (the phone killing the page under memory pressure, a host refresh) used to land on the home page with the dashboard gone. The hash survives a reload, and the restore check below reopens the dashboard from it — the dashboard now stays the dashboard until the owner closes it. */if(!wasOpen&&location.hash!=='#dashboard'){try{history.pushState({pvDash:1},'','#dashboard');}catch(e){}}dash.scrollTop=0;dashArea=null;renderPills();renderDetail();document.dispatchEvent(new Event('pv-dash-reset'));}
function closeDash(){if(!dash.classList.contains('open'))return;dash.classList.remove('open');unlockScroll();if(location.hash==='#dashboard'){try{history.replaceState(null,'',location.pathname+location.search);}catch(e){}}}
$('#dashClose').addEventListener('click',closeDash);
$('#dashLogout').addEventListener('click',()=>{closeDash();toast(LANG==='es'?'Sesión cerrada. ¡Hasta pronto!':'Logged out. See you soon!');});

 {id:'settings',ic:'⚙️',en:'Settings',es:'Ajustes'}];
let dashArea=null;
function renderGlance(){
  const box=$('#dashGlance');if(!box)return;
  const es=LANG==='es',n=LEADS.length;
  const cards=[
    {id:'leads',n:n,unit:es?'nuevas':'new',label:es?'Consultas nuevas':'New Inquiries',sub:n?(es?'Toca para ver la más reciente':'Tap to view the latest'):(es?'Sin nuevas aún · 2 ejemplos dentro':'None new yet · 2 samples inside'),hot:n>0},
    {id:'events',n:2,unit:es?'ejemplos':'samples',label:es?'Eventos próximos':'Upcoming Events',sub:es?'Siguiente: gala navideña (ejemplo)':'Next: Holiday gala (sample)',hot:false},
    {id:'messages',n:2,unit:es?'ejemplos':'samples',label:es?'Mensajes':'Messages',sub:es?'Instagram + correo · ejemplos':'Instagram + email · samples',hot:false}];
  const gs=$('#glanceSum');if(gs)gs.textContent=es?`${n} nuevas · 2 eventos · 2 mensajes`:`${n} new · 2 events · 2 messages`;
  box.innerHTML=`<div class="glance-grid">${cards.map(c=>`<button class="glance-card ${c.hot?'hot':''}" data-glance="${c.id}"><span class="gn">${c.n}<span class="gu">${c.unit}</span></span><span class="gl">${c.label}</span><span class="gs">${c.sub}</span></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
  box.querySelectorAll('[data-glance]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{dashArea=b.dataset.glance;renderPills();renderDetail();detail.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'});}));
}
function renderPills(){
  renderGlance();
  const box=$('#dashPills');if(!box)return;
  box.innerHTML=PILLS.map(p=>{
    let badge='';
    if(p.id==='leads'&&LEADS.length)badge=`<span class="pb">${LEADS.length} new</span>`;
    if(p.id==='events')badge=`<span class="pb gold">2</span>`;
    if(p.id==='lvlb')badge=`<span class="pb gold">2</span>`;
    if(p.id==='messages')badge=`<span class="pb">2</span>`;
    if(p.id==='reviews')badge=`<span class="pb gold">5.0 ★</span>`;
    return `<button class="pill ${dashArea===p.id?'on':''}" data-pill="${p.id}"><span class="pi">${p.ic}</span><span class="pl">${LANG==='es'?p.es:p.en}</span>${badge}<span class="pc" aria-hidden="true">›</span></button>`;
  }).join('');
  box.querySelectorAll('[data-pill]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{dashArea=b.dataset.pill;renderPills();renderDetail();detail.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'});}));
}

    let cells=(es?['Domingo','Lunes','Martes','Miércoles','Jueves','Viernes','Sábado']:['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday']).map(d=>`<div class="dow">${d}</div>`).join('');
    for(let i=0;i<first;i++)cells+='<div></div>';
    for(let d=1;d<=days;d++){const cls=d===now.getDate()?'today':(d===now.getDate()+3||d===now.getDate()+9?'ev':'');cells+=`<div class="${cls}">${d}${cls==='ev'?' •':''}</div>`;}
    h=`<h3>📅 ${es?'Calendario':'Calendar'} — ${names[m]} ${y}</h3><p style="color:var(--muted)">${es?'Hoy está marcado. Los puntos dorados son reservas de ejemplo.':'Today is outlined. Gold dots are sample holds.'}</p><div class="cal">${cells}</div>

    `<div class="ditem"><b>${es?'Alquileres estrella':'Star rentals'}</b><p>LED dance floors · custom LED walls · CO2 jets + guns · sparkulars · LED mobile billboards · cigar rollers · love seats + sweetheart chairs</p></div>`;

    `<div class="ditem"><b>${es?'Comunidad':'Community'}</b><p>${COMMUNITY.join(' · ')}</p></div>`;
  }
  if(dashArea==='settings'){
    h=`<h3>⚙️ ${es?'Ajustes':'Settings'}</h3>
    <div class="setrow"><div><b>Ask Vibes</b><p>${es?'El agente de chat abajo a la derecha para visitantes.':'The bottom-right chat agent for visitors.'}</p></div><button class="tgl on" id="setAgent">ON</button></div>
    <div class="setrow"><div><b>${es?'Idioma del sitio':'Site language'}</b><p>EN / ES — ${es?'aplica a todo el sitio':'applies site-wide'}</p></div><button class="tgl" id="setLang">${LANG==='es'?'ES':'EN'}</button></div>
    <div class="setrow"><div><b>${es?'Muro de marcas en movimiento':'Brand marquee motion'}</b><p>${es?'Pausa la marquesina de marcas.':'Pause the scrolling brand wall.'}</p></div><button class="tgl" id="setMotion">${es?'Pausar':'Pause'}</button></div>
    <div class="setrow"><div><b>${es?'Contacto público':'Public contact'}</b><p>info@premierevibes.com · +1 (347) 709-6712 · @PremiereVibes</p></div></div>`;
    setTimeout(()=>{
      const a=$('#setAgent');if(a)a.addEventListener('click',()=>{const fab=$('#agentFab');const off=fab.style.display==='none';fab.style.display=off?'grid':'none';if(off===false)$('#agentPanel').classList.remove('open');a.textContent=off?'ON':'OFF';a.classList.toggle('on',off);});
      const l=$('#setLang');if(l)l.addEventListener('click',()=>{setLang(LANG==='en'?'es':'en');renderDetail();});
      const mo=$('#setMotion');if(mo)mo.addEventListener('click',()=>{const t=$('#mqTrack');const paused=t.style.animationPlayState==='paused';t.style.animationPlayState=paused?'running':'paused';mo.textContent=paused?(LANG==='es'?'Pausar':'Pause'):(LANG==='es'?'Reanudar':'Resume');mo.classList.toggle('on',!paused);});
    },0);
  }
  detail.innerHTML=`<button class="dash-back" id="dashBack" type="button">← ${es?'Volver al panel':'Back to dashboard'}</button>`+h;
  const bk=$('#dashBack');if(bk)bk.addEventListener('click',()=>{dashArea=null;renderPills();renderDetail();dash.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});});
}
renderPills();
/* AUTO-REFRESH FIX, phase 2 — dashboard restore: registered at the END
   of this block, after dashArea is initialized and every dashboard
   listener is wired (calling openDash any earlier hits the let-TDZ on
   dashArea and aborts the block). If the page (re)loads with #dashboard
   in the URL — which is where openDash leaves it — the dashboard
   reopens itself instead of dropping the owner back on the home page;
   browser Back away from the hash closes it like the ✕ does. */
window.addEventListener('popstate',function(){var want=location.hash==='#dashboard';if(want&&!dash.classList.contains('open'))openDash();else if(!want&&dash.classList.contains('open'))closeDash();});
if(location.hash==='#dashboard')openDash();
/* Dashboard groups are ALWAYS visible and organized (Taylor's order):
   At a glance cards and the All areas tiles render in the open — no
   collapsible header rows hide them. Only the pipelines and ops cards
   below expand their full detail on tap. */
</script>
<script>
/* Showreel — instant start + unbroken audio on iPhone, independent of how
   the host serves the file.
   Two facts established by Taylor's own A/B test: the SAME file plays
   perfectly from the Netlify link and stalls on the Muse artifact. The
   file is not the problem (fast-start H.264 yuv420p limited-range + AAC,
   fully decodes clean) — the artifact host's media serving is: its
   Content-Type / byte-range behaviour is what iPhone Safari chokes on,
   while Netlify streams it properly. The direct-src player below the hero
   therefore depended on exactly the thing that is broken here.
   Fix — the same principle that repaired the "Feel the vibes" slideshow:
   the reel is primed up front over a plain fetch() GET (the channel that
   already serves this page's photos) and handed to the player as a blob:
   URL typed video/mp4, so playback depends neither on the host's media
   Content-Type nor on its byte-range support. The blob is swapped in
   while the reel is still paused at frame 0, so the first tap calls
   play() synchronously inside the tap gesture, unmuted, on the blob
   copy — audio runs from frame 0 and is never switched mid-stream, and
   the speaker button stays the only mute control. If the direct load
   errors, or a tap has not reached playable data within a few seconds,
   the player is rescued onto its blob copy the same way; if the direct
   load proves healthy first, it is left alone. While a tapped reel is
   fetching its first frame the centre pill shows a spinner, so a tap
   never looks dead. */
(function(){
  var v=document.getElementById('pvReel'),stage=document.getElementById('reelStage'),snd=document.getElementById('reelSnd');
  if(!v||!stage||!snd)return;
  v.playsInline=true;
  v.setAttribute('playsinline','');
  v.setAttribute('webkit-playsinline','');
  /* AUTO-REFRESH FIX, phase 2: metadata only. preload="auto" made the
     browser buffer the whole 5.6MB reel at page load and hold it for the
     entire visit — pure memory pressure toward the phone killing the
     page and reloading it. The poster carries the still; the first tap
     streams the file (play() forces the load) exactly as before. */
  v.preload='metadata';
  var started=false, directOk=false, stallTimer=null;
  var src=v.getAttribute('src');
  /* AUTO-REFRESH FIX: blob priming is OFF, permanently. The old engine
     fetch()'d whole videos into memory as blob URLs while the user
     scrolled; holding ~72MB of video in RAM got the phone's webview
     killed and the page reloaded by itself mid-scroll. The page must
     never refresh on its own — videos now stream directly from their
     file src (the browser streams with bounded memory), and nothing in
     this page fetches a video into memory or resets a video's src. */
  var canBlob=false;
  var blobUrl=null, fetching=false;
  function fetchBlob(done){
    if(blobUrl){ if(done)done(true); return; }
    if(fetching){
      var iv=setInterval(function(){ if(!fetching){ clearInterval(iv); if(done)done(!!blobUrl); } },250);
      return;
    }
    if(!canBlob){ if(done)done(false); return; }
    fetching=true;
    function ok(buf){ try{ blobUrl=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([buf],{type:'video/mp4'})); }catch(e){} fetching=false; if(done)done(!!blobUrl); }
    function bad(){ fetching=false; if(done)done(false); }
    fetch(src).then(function(r){ if(!r.ok)throw new Error('http'); return r.arrayBuffer(); }).then(ok).catch(function(){
      fetch(src,{mode:'no-cors'}).then(function(r){ return r.blob(); }).then(function(b){ return b.arrayBuffer(); }).then(ok).catch(bad);
    });
  }
  function syncSnd(){
    snd.classList.toggle('live',!v.muted);
    snd.setAttribute('aria-label',v.muted?'Turn sound on':'Turn sound off');
  }
  function sync(){
    var on=!v.paused&&!v.ended;
    stage.classList.toggle('playing',on);
    if(on)stage.classList.remove('loading');
    syncSnd();
  }
  function play(){try{var p=v.play();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){});}catch(e){}}
  function playRescue(){
    var p=null; try{ p=v.play(); }catch(e){}
    if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){
      /* an unmuted replay refused outside the tap gesture: leave the pill
         up (blob src is in place) so the next tap plays synchronously */
      stage.classList.remove('loading');
    });
  }
  function clearStall(){ if(stallTimer){ clearTimeout(stallTimer); stallTimer=null; } }
  function swapIn(replay){
    if(!blobUrl)return;
    if(v.getAttribute('src')!==blobUrl){
      var wasMuted=v.muted;
      v.src=blobUrl; v.muted=wasMuted;
      try{ v.load(); }catch(e){}
    }
    if(replay)playRescue();
  }
  function rescue(replay){
    if(!canBlob){ stage.classList.remove('loading'); return; }
    if(blobUrl){ swapIn(replay); return; }
    fetchBlob(function(ok2){ if(ok2)swapIn(replay); else stage.classList.remove('loading'); });
  }
  function armStall(){
    clearStall();
    stallTimer=setTimeout(function(){
      stallTimer=null;
      if(v.paused||v.ended)return;
      if(v.readyState>=3)return;
      rescue(true);
    },5000);
  }
  function startPlayback(){
    if(v.error||v.networkState===3){ if(blobUrl)swapIn(false); else { try{ v.load(); }catch(err){} } }
    if(!started){ started=true; v.muted=false; v.defaultMuted=false; }
    if(v.readyState<3)stage.classList.add('loading');
    play();
    armStall();
  }
  stage.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(e.target&&e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('#reelSnd'))return;
    if(v.paused||v.ended)startPlayback();
    else v.pause();
    sync();
  });
  v.addEventListener('play',sync);
  v.addEventListener('playing',function(){
    clearStall(); stage.classList.remove('loading');
    if(v.currentSrc&&v.currentSrc.indexOf('blob:')!==0)directOk=true;
    sync();
  });
  v.addEventListener('canplay',function(){ if(!v.paused)stage.classList.remove('loading'); });
  v.addEventListener('waiting',function(){ if(!v.paused&&v.readyState<3){ stage.classList.add('loading'); armStall(); } });
  v.addEventListener('pause',function(){ clearStall(); stage.classList.remove('loading'); sync(); });
  v.addEventListener('ended',function(){ clearStall(); stage.classList.remove('loading'); sync(); });
  v.addEventListener('error',function(){
    clearStall();
    if(v.getAttribute('src')&&v.getAttribute('src').indexOf('blob:')===0){ stage.classList.remove('loading'); return; }
    rescue(!v.paused);
  });
  v.addEventListener('volumechange',syncSnd);
  /* background suspension: a full-screen surface opening over the hero
     pauses the reel — no audio or decoding behind a dashboard/view */
  document.addEventListener('pv-suspend',function(){ if(!v.paused){ try{ v.pause(); }catch(e){} } });
  snd.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.preventDefault();
    v.muted=!v.muted;
    if(!v.muted)started=true;
    if(!v.muted&&(v.paused||v.ended))startPlayback();
    sync();
  });
  /* prime the blob copy up front; swap it in only while the reel is still
     untouched, so a healthy direct load is never disturbed mid-playback */
  fetchBlob(function(ok){
    if(ok&&v.paused&&v.currentTime===0&&!directOk)swapIn(false);
  });
  syncSnd();
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ================= CINEMATIC SCROLL JOURNEY =================
   iPhone-first: transform/opacity only, one passive rAF scroll loop,
   waveform animates only while on screen, everything off under reduced-motion. */
(function(){
  var reduce=false;
  try{reduce=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;}catch(e){}
  /* --- Spanish strings for the cinematic sections (EN lives in the markup) --- */
  if(typeof ES!=='undefined'){
    ES.scrl='Desliza &gt;';
    ES.cfKick='Audio / Visual · Sonido · Iluminación';
    ES.cfH='Siente la <em>frecuencia</em>';
    ES.cfP='<span class="fs-beat fs-b1">Soporte AV <span class="fs-k fs-k1">impecable</span> para eventos de cualquier tamaño.</span><span class="fs-beat fs-b2">De <b>lanzamientos</b> a <b>conferencias</b>:</span><span class="fs-beat fs-b3"><span class="fs-sub fs-s1">técnicos <span class="fs-k fs-k2">expertos</span>,</span><span class="fs-sub fs-s2">equipo <span class="fs-k fs-k3">de última generación</span></span><span class="fs-sub fs-s3">y coordinación eficiente en sitio.</span></span><span class="fs-beat fs-b4">Nosotros manejamos lo técnico</span><span class="fs-beat fs-b5">para que tu evento salga <span class="fs-k fs-kf">perfecto.</span></span>';
    ES.vidH='Feel the <span class="fv-grad">vibes</span>';
    ES.vidSwipe='Desliza';
    ES.ceKick='Cómo <em>funciona</em>';
    ES.ce1t='Imagina';
    ES.ce2t='Crea';
    ES.ce3t='Vive la experiencia';
    ES.csKick='Servicios para eventos';
    ES.webHubSub='Un solo equipo · Los 9 servicios';
    ES.webOpen='Toca para ver el detalle completo →';
    ES.webFull='Ver el detalle completo →';
    ES.ccKick='Vida nocturna y eventos públicos';ES.ccH='Más que <em>música</em>';
    ES.ccP='Nuestro escenario de conciertos, con iluminación y audio de última generación, es una marca de la casa: gira nacionalmente o se instala por completo en nuestro patio de NYC con tu artista favorito.';
    ES.ccCta='Ver los trabajos →';
    ES.ctKick='Tu evento empieza aquí';ES.ctH='¿Listo para empezar <em>tu evento?</em>';
    ES.ctP='Cuéntanos de tu evento y el equipo lo diseñará contigo.';
    ES.ctCta='Comienza tu evento →';
  }
  /* ===== CONSTELLATION WHEEL — the 9-service spider-web module =====
     Compact and seamless: nodes sit in FIXED slots and never move, so every
     name, icon and number exists exactly once — no rotation, no drag-spin,
     no ghost or doubled labels, no overlap. The only travellers are one
     gold ring gliding cell to cell (transform-only, one eased transition)
     and the detail surface (bottom-sheet drawer on mobile, floating glass
     card on desktop). Selection is a single synchronous state — rapid taps
     simply retarget the one transition, so nothing can stack or desync.
     Ambient: every node breathes with a soft staggered aura (opacity only).
     Focus: the chosen node locks gold, and only its direct spoke to the

  function openService(i){

  }
  /* --- animated waveform: deep layered glowing waves + a living EQ, AV-style ---

      ambGrad.addColorStop(0,'rgba(139,46,255,.13)');
      ambGrad.addColorStop(.6,'rgba(255,46,126,.05)');
      ambGrad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(139,46,255,0)');
    }
    function resetBars(){
      barCount=(W<640)?36:56;
      barH=[];barPeak=[];
      for(var i=0;i<barCount;i++){barH.push(4);barPeak.push(4);}
    }
    function size(){
      var dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,1.5);
      W=cv.clientWidth;H=cv.clientHeight;
      cv.width=Math.round(W*dpr);cv.height=Math.round(H*dpr);
      ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
      buildGrads();resetBars();
      /* settle the EQ through a few virtual frames so even the very first
         (or reduced-motion static) frame looks alive, never flat or blank */
      for(var k=0;k<26;k++)draw(1200+k*90);
    }
    function waveY(w,x,t,midY){
      var env=.35+.65*Math.sin(Math.PI*x/W);
      var pc=((t*.028)%(W*1.5))-W*.25;
      var dx=(x-pc)/(W*.16);
      env*=1+.30*Math.exp(-dx*dx);
      var breath=.86+.14*Math.sin(t*.00045+w.freq*160);
      return midY+(Math.sin(x*w.freq+t*.0011*w.speed*2.2)*H*w.amp
             +Math.sin(x*w.freq*2.7+t*.0017*w.speed)*H*w.amp*.32)*env*breath;
    }
    function barPath(x,y,w,h,r){
      r=Math.min(r,w/2,h);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x,y+h);
      ctx.lineTo(x,y+r);ctx.arc(x+r,y+r,r,Math.PI,Math.PI*1.5);
      ctx.lineTo(x+w-r,y);ctx.arc(x+w-r,y+r,r,Math.PI*1.5,0);
      ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h);
      ctx.closePath();
    }
    function draw(t){
      if(!W||!H)return;
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
      var midY=H*.54,narrow=W<640,step=narrow?7:5;
      /* ambient palette wash behind everything */
      ctx.fillStyle=ambGrad;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
      /* soft under-glow beneath the lead (pink) wave */
      var lead=WAVES[2];
      ctx.beginPath();
      for(var x0=0;x0<=W;x0+=step){
        var y0=waveY(lead,x0,t,midY);
        if(x0===0)ctx.moveTo(x0,y0);else ctx.lineTo(x0,y0);
      }
      ctx.lineTo(W,midY+H*.34);ctx.lineTo(0,midY+H*.34);ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle=fillGrad;ctx.fill();
      /* faint centre line */
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,midY);ctx.lineTo(W,midY);
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(245,242,236,.07)';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();
      /* the five wave layers, deepest first */
      WAVES.forEach(function(w,wi){
        ctx.beginPath();
        for(var x=0;x<=W;x+=step){
          var y=waveY(w,x,t,midY);
          if(x===0)ctx.moveTo(x,y);else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
        }
        ctx.strokeStyle=waveGrads[wi]||'#fff';
        ctx.lineWidth=w.lw;ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.lineCap='round';
        if(w.glow&&!narrow){ctx.shadowBlur=9;ctx.shadowColor=w.glow;}
        ctx.stroke();ctx.shadowBlur=0;
      });
      /* living EQ — fast attack, slow release, peak-hold caps, spectrum colours */
      var bars=barCount||((W<640)?36:56),bw=W/bars;
      var beat=Math.pow(Math.max(0,Math.sin(t*.0016)),3);
      ctx.fillStyle=eqGrad;
      for(var i=0;i<bars;i++){
        var u=bars>1?i/(bars-1):0;
        var base=Math.abs(Math.sin(i*.62+t*.0016))*.55+Math.abs(Math.sin(i*.21-t*.0011))*.30+Math.abs(Math.sin(i*1.7+t*.0023))*.25;
        var target=3+H*.15*base+beat*H*.11*(1-u)*(1-u)+Math.sin(t*.00045+i*.14)*H*.012;
        var maxH=H*.30;if(target>maxH)target=maxH;if(target<3)target=3;
        var cur=barH[i]||4;
        cur+=(target-cur)*(target>cur?.5:.16);
        barH[i]=cur;
        var pk=barPeak[i]||4;
        if(cur>pk)pk=cur;else pk=Math.max(cur,pk-.45);
        barPeak[i]=pk;
        var bx=i*bw+bw*.26,bwid=bw*.48,by=H-6-cur;
        ctx.globalAlpha=.88;
        barPath(bx,by,bwid,cur,2);ctx.fill();
        /* peak-hold cap */
        ctx.globalAlpha=.95;
        ctx.fillRect(bx,H-9.5-pk,bwid,2);
        ctx.globalAlpha=1;
      }
      /* baseline shimmer under the EQ */
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(232,179,75,.16)';
      ctx.fillRect(0,H-3,W,1);
    }
    function loop(t){
      /* AUTO-REFRESH FIX, phase 2: the canvas sits under any open
         full-screen surface (dashboard/views) and IntersectionObserver
         still counts it visible there — without the suspend check it
         kept drawing at 30fps behind the dashboard for the whole visit,
         adding to the pressure that got the page killed and reloaded. */
      if(!visible||window.__pvSuspended){rafId=null;return;}
      frame++;
      if(frame%2===0)draw(t||0); /* ~30fps: plenty for a wave, half the battery */
      rafId=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
    size();
    var rto=null;
    window.addEventListener('resize',function(){clearTimeout(rto);rto=setTimeout(size,160);},{passive:true});
    document.addEventListener('pv-resume',function(){ if(visible&&!rafId&&!reduce)rafId=requestAnimationFrame(loop); });
    if(reduce){draw(1400);}
    else if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
      new IntersectionObserver(function(es){
        es.forEach(function(x){
          visible=x.isIntersecting;
          if(visible&&!rafId&&!window.__pvSuspended)rafId=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        });
      },{rootMargin:'120px'}).observe(cv);
    } else { visible=true; rafId=requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
  }
  /* --- gentle parallax on hero + crowd imagery: one passive rAF loop, transforms only --- */
  var pEls=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-para]'));
  if(!reduce&&pEls.length){
    var ticking=false;
    function upd(){
      ticking=false;
      var vh=window.innerHeight;
      pEls.forEach(function(el){
        var host=el.closest('section')||el.parentElement;
        var r=host.getBoundingClientRect();
        if(r.bottom<-120||r.top>vh+120)return;
        var prog=(r.top+r.height/2-vh/2)/vh;
        var f=parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-para'))||0.06;
        var y=(-prog*f*220).toFixed(1);
        var sc=el.getAttribute('data-para-scale');
        el.style.transform='translate3d(0,'+y+'px,0)'+(sc?(' scale('+sc+')'):'');
        el.style.willChange='transform';
      });
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){
      if(!ticking){ticking=true;requestAnimationFrame(upd);}
    },{passive:true});
    upd();
  }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ================= AWARD PASS — camera, kinetic type, horizontal chapter, magnetic =================
   Higgsfield-style moves recreated in code: a slow dolly-in on load, scroll-linked
   camera advance/reverse on the hero, a scroll-driven horizontal chapter, and a
   whisper of handheld sway (CSS). Everything is transform/opacity only, driven by
   one passive rAF pump; reduced motion turns the camera and chapter pinning off. */
(function(){
  var reduce=false; try{reduce=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;}catch(e){}
  var finePointer=false; try{finePointer=window.matchMedia('(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)').matches;}catch(e){}
  var clamp01=function(v){return v<0?0:v>1?1:v;};

  /* ---------- horizontal chapter state (used by the pump below) ---------- */
  var hwrap=document.getElementById('hwrap'), htrack=document.getElementById('htrack'),
      hfill=document.getElementById('hpFill'), hcur=document.getElementById('hpCur');
  var hLive=false, hPanels=htrack?[].slice.call(htrack.children):[];
  function hMode(){
    if(!hwrap)return;
    var live=!reduce && window.matchMedia('(min-width:901px)').matches;
    if(live!==hLive){ hLive=live; hwrap.classList.toggle('live',live); if(!live&&htrack)htrack.style.transform=''; }
  }
  function hUpdate(){
    if(!hwrap||!htrack)return;
    var pr=0;
    if(hLive){
      var r=hwrap.getBoundingClientRect(), vh=window.innerHeight;
      var total=hwrap.offsetHeight-vh; if(total<=0)total=1;
      pr=clamp01(-r.top/total);
      var maxX=Math.max(0,htrack.scrollWidth-hwrap.clientWidth);
      htrack.style.transform='translate3d('+(-pr*maxX).toFixed(1)+'px,0,0)';
      hPanels.forEach(function(pn,i){
        var img=pn.querySelector('.hp-img:not(.whole) img'); if(!img)return;
        var local=clamp01(1-Math.abs(pr*(hPanels.length-1)-i));
        img.style.transform='scale('+(1.13-0.11*local).toFixed(3)+')';
      });
    } else {
      var maxS=htrack.scrollWidth-htrack.clientWidth;
      pr=maxS>0?clamp01(htrack.scrollLeft/maxS):0;
    }
    if(hfill)hfill.style.width=(pr*100).toFixed(1)+'%';
    if(hcur&&hPanels.length)hcur.textContent='0'+(Math.round(pr*(hPanels.length-1))+1);
  }
  if(htrack)htrack.addEventListener('scroll',function(){ if(!hLive)hUpdate(); },{passive:true});

  /* ---------- scroll progress + hero camera, one pump ---------- */
  var prog=document.getElementById('scrollProg');
  var heroImg=document.querySelector('[data-cam="hero"]');
  var heroAlive=document.querySelector('.hero-alive');
  var heroSec=heroImg?heroImg.closest('.hero'):null;
  var heroRing=document.querySelector('.hero-ring');
  var heroIn=heroSec?heroSec.querySelector('.hero-in'):null;
  var dollyT0=null, rafP=false;
  function pump(now){
    rafP=false;
    if(prog){
      var h=document.documentElement, max=h.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight;
      prog.style.transform='scaleX('+(max>0?clamp01(window.scrollY/max):0)+')';
    }
    if(heroImg&&!reduce){
      if(dollyT0===null)dollyT0=now;
      var dt=clamp01((now-dollyT0)/2400), de=1-Math.pow(1-dt,3);
      var hh=(heroSec&&heroSec.offsetHeight)||window.innerHeight;
      var p=clamp01(window.scrollY/Math.max(1,hh));
      var sc=(1.17-0.09*de)+p*0.05;
      heroImg.style.transform='translate3d(0,'+(p*44).toFixed(1)+'px,0) scale('+sc.toFixed(4)+')';
      if(heroAlive)heroAlive.style.transform=heroImg.style.transform;
      if(dt<1)requestPump();
    }
    /* depth plane 2: the glow ring drifts against the scroll at its own rate */
    if(heroRing&&!reduce){
      var rp=clamp01(window.scrollY/Math.max(1,window.innerHeight));
      heroRing.style.transform='translate3d(0,'+(-rp*30).toFixed(1)+'px,0)';
    }
    hUpdate(); kinCheck();
  }
  function requestPump(){ if(!rafP){ rafP=true; requestAnimationFrame(pump); } }
  window.addEventListener('scroll',requestPump,{passive:true});
  /* depth plane 3: headline block tilts a whisper toward the pointer —
     desktop fine-pointer only, never on touch, never under reduced motion */
  if(finePointer&&!reduce&&heroSec&&heroIn){
    var tiltRaf=false;
    heroSec.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){
      if(tiltRaf)return; tiltRaf=true;
      requestAnimationFrame(function(){
        tiltRaf=false;
        var r=heroSec.getBoundingClientRect();
        var dx=(e.clientX-r.left)/Math.max(1,r.width)-0.5, dy=(e.clientY-r.top)/Math.max(1,r.height)-0.5;
        heroIn.style.transform='rotateX('+(-dy*2.4).toFixed(2)+'deg) rotateY('+(dx*2.4).toFixed(2)+'deg)';
      });
    });
    heroSec.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){ heroIn.style.transform=''; });
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize',function(){ hMode(); requestPump(); },{passive:true});

  /* ---------- kinetic headings: masked word reveals on arrival ---------- */
  var kinHeads=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.cine h2,.hub-h,.brands-head h2'));
  var kio=null;
  function splitWords(el){
    var idx=0;
    (function walk(node){
      [].slice.call(node.childNodes).forEach(function(n){
        if(n.nodeType===3){
          var frag=document.createDocumentFragment();
          n.textContent.split(/(\s+)/).forEach(function(part){
            if(!part)return;
            if(/^\s+$/.test(part)){ frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' ')); }
            else{
              var w=document.createElement('span'); w.className='kw';
              var inn=document.createElement('span'); inn.className='kw-in';
              inn.style.setProperty('--d',(idx++*0.055)+'s'); inn.textContent=part;
              w.appendChild(inn); frag.appendChild(w);
            }
          });
          node.replaceChild(frag,n);
        } else if(n.nodeType===1) walk(n);
      });
    })(el);
    el.dataset.split='1';
  }
  function armKinetic(){
    kinHeads.forEach(function(h){
      if(h.dataset.split)return;
      var wasIn=h.classList.contains('kin-in');
      splitWords(h);
      if(wasIn){
        h.classList.add('kin-snap');
        requestAnimationFrame(function(){ requestAnimationFrame(function(){ h.classList.remove('kin-snap'); }); });
      } else if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
        if(!kio)kio=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){ es.forEach(function(x){ if(x.isIntersecting){ x.target.classList.add('kin-in'); kio.unobserve(x.target); } }); },{threshold:.25});
        kio.observe(h);
      } else h.classList.add('kin-in');
    });
  }
  armKinetic();
  /* Reveal is scroll-driven via the pump (deterministic in every viewport, incl.
     full-page captures) with a hard timer fallback — a heading must never stay hidden. */
  function kinCheck(){
    kinHeads.forEach(function(h){
      if(h.classList.contains('kin-in')||!h.dataset.split)return;
      var r=h.getBoundingClientRect();
      if(r.top<window.innerHeight*.92&&r.bottom>0)h.classList.add('kin-in');
    });
  }
  setTimeout(function(){ kinHeads.forEach(function(h){ h.classList.add('kin-in'); }); },2000);
  /* language flips rewrite heading innerHTML — re-split afterwards */
  if(typeof setLang==='function'){
    var _prevAward=setLang;
    setLang=function(l){
      _prevAward(l);
      kinHeads.forEach(function(h){ delete h.dataset.split; });
      armKinetic(); hMode(); hUpdate();
    };
  }

  /* ---------- magnetic primary buttons — desktop fine pointer only ---------- */
  if(finePointer&&!reduce){
    document.querySelectorAll('.magnet').forEach(function(b){
      var raf=null;
      b.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){
        var r=b.getBoundingClientRect();
        var dx=e.clientX-(r.left+r.width/2), dy=e.clientY-(r.top+r.height/2);
        var tx=Math.max(-7,Math.min(7,dx*.22)), ty=Math.max(-5,Math.min(5,dy*.28));
        if(raf)cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
        raf=requestAnimationFrame(function(){ b.style.transform='translate('+tx.toFixed(1)+'px,'+ty.toFixed(1)+'px)'; });
      });
      b.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){ if(raf)cancelAnimationFrame(raf); b.style.transform=''; });
    });
  }

  hMode();
  requestPump();
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ================= FEEL THE VIBES — video slideshow =================
   One video at a time. ONLY the first video needs a press on play:
   that first tap unmutes synchronously inside the tap gesture, then
   calls play() — audio runs from frame 0 and is never switched
   mid-stream, and that gesture unlocks audio for the whole slideshow.
   After the unlock, every video AUTOPLAYS WITH SOUND as soon as it
   becomes the current slide — by swipe, the slideshow's only
   navigation (there is no control row) — with no play press needed
   on slides 2 through 14. Stepping or swiping away pauses the video
   left behind (audio never overlaps between slides), and scrolling
   the slideshow off screen pauses whatever is playing. Tapping the
   current video still pauses/resumes it, and each slide's speaker
   button stays its only mute control.

   Loading strategy — REPAIRED after the first build failed on iPhone.
   What was wrong: every file sat at preload="none" and the warmer only ever
   warmed the NEIGHBOURS of the current slide, never the current slide
   itself, so on a phone every single tap was a cold start — a multi-MB
   media fetch through the artifact host that only began at the tap, and
   whose failure was swallowed by an empty promise catch. All 14 videos sat
   on their posters forever, which is why "none of them work" rather than
   one bad file (the files themselves probe and decode clean: fast-start
   H.264 yuv420p limited-range + AAC-LC, same recipe as the working reel).
   Now: the current slide (then its neighbours, in order) is fetched up
   front over a plain fetch() GET — the channel that already serves this
   page's photos — and handed to the player as a blob: URL typed video/mp4,
   so playback depends neither on the host's media Content-Type nor on its
   byte-range support. A slide whose direct load errors, or whose tap has
   not reached playable data within a few seconds, is rescued onto its blob
   copy the same way. While a tapped video is fetching its first frame the
   centre pill shows a spinner, so a tap never looks dead. Blob copies for
   slides far from the current one are released to bound memory. */
(function(){
  var track=document.getElementById('vidTrack');
  if(!track)return;
  var reduce=false; try{reduce=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;}catch(e){}
  var slides=[].slice.call(track.children), N=slides.length, cur=0, tick=false;
  var swipeHint=document.getElementById('vidSwipeHint');
  function es(){ return (typeof LANG!=='undefined'&&LANG==='es'); }
  function sndName(muted){ return muted ? (es()?'Activar el sonido':'Turn sound on') : (es()?'Silenciar':'Turn sound off'); }
  function tryPlay(v){ try{ var p=v.play(); if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){}); }catch(e){} }
  /* AUTO-REFRESH FIX: canBlob is hard-off — see the showreel engine's
     note. Scrolling used to trigger fetch() priming of whole video
     files into memory (plus src resets on far slides); that memory
     churn is what got the page killed and reloaded mid-scroll on the
     phone. Direct streaming only: queuePrime falls back to preload,
     releaseFar has nothing to release, playback logic is unchanged. */
  var canBlob=false;
  var blobs={}, fetching={};
  /* Audio unlock: false until the user presses play on the first video
     (or unmutes via a speaker button). Before that, no slide autoplays.
     Once true, slide changes autoplay the incoming slide with sound. */
  var audioUnlocked=false;
  function fetchBlob(i,done){
    if(blobs[i]){ if(done)done(true); return; }
    if(fetching[i]){
      var iv=setInterval(function(){ if(!fetching[i]){ clearInterval(iv); if(done)done(!!blobs[i]); } },250);
      return;
    }
    fetching[i]=true;
    var url=states[i].src;
    function ok(buf){ try{ blobs[i]=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([buf],{type:'video/mp4'})); }catch(e){} fetching[i]=false; if(done)done(!!blobs[i]); }
    function bad(){ fetching[i]=false; if(done)done(false); }
    fetch(url).then(function(r){ if(!r.ok)throw new Error('http'); return r.arrayBuffer(); }).then(ok).catch(function(){
      fetch(url,{mode:'no-cors'}).then(function(r){ return r.blob(); }).then(function(b){ return b.arrayBuffer(); }).then(ok).catch(bad);
    });
  }
  var states=slides.map(function(slide,i){
    var v=slide.querySelector('video'), stage=slide.querySelector('.vid-stage'), snd=slide.querySelector('.vid-snd');
    var st={v:v,stage:stage,snd:snd,src:v.getAttribute('src'),started:false,soundOn:false,directOk:false,stallTimer:null,pendingAutoplay:false};
    v.playsInline=true; v.setAttribute('playsinline',''); v.setAttribute('webkit-playsinline','');
    function syncSnd(){ snd.classList.toggle('live',!v.muted); snd.setAttribute('aria-label',sndName(v.muted)); }
    function sync(){ var on=!v.paused&&!v.ended; stage.classList.toggle('playing',on); stage.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on?'true':'false'); if(on)stage.classList.remove('loading'); syncSnd(); }
    st.sync=sync;
    st.syncLabels=function(){ syncSnd(); stage.setAttribute('aria-label',(es()?'Video ':'Video ')+(i+1)+(es()?' de 14 — toca para reproducir o pausar':' of 14 — tap to play or pause')); };
    function clearStall(){ if(st.stallTimer){ clearTimeout(st.stallTimer); st.stallTimer=null; } }
    st.clearStall=clearStall;
    function playRescue(){
      var p=null; try{ p=v.play(); }catch(e){}
      if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){
        if(v.paused){ v.muted=true; st.soundOn=false; syncSnd(); tryPlay(v); }
      });
    }
    function swapIn(replay){
      if(!blobs[i])return;
      if(v.getAttribute('src')!==blobs[i]){
        var wasMuted=v.muted;
        v.src=blobs[i]; v.muted=wasMuted;
        try{ v.load(); }catch(e){}
      }
      if(replay)playRescue();
    }
    st.swapIn=swapIn;
    function rescue(replay){
      if(!canBlob)return;
      if(blobs[i]){ swapIn(replay); return; }
      fetchBlob(i,function(ok2){ if(ok2)swapIn(replay); else stage.classList.remove('loading'); });
    }
    st.rescue=rescue;
    function armStall(){
      clearStall();
      st.stallTimer=setTimeout(function(){
        st.stallTimer=null;
        if(v.paused||v.ended)return;
        if(v.readyState>=3)return;
        rescue(true);
      },6000);
    }
    /* Autoplay entry point for slide changes: called when this slide
       becomes current AFTER the audio unlock. Always plays WITH sound,
       pauses every other slide first so audio never overlaps, and marks
       itself pending so a canplay that arrives late can retry the start
       (a manual tap-to-pause clears the pending flag, so this can never
       override a deliberate pause). */
    function autoplay(){
      if(!audioUnlocked)return;
      if(!v.paused&&!v.ended){ st.pendingAutoplay=false; return; }
      if(v.ended){ try{ v.currentTime=0; }catch(e){} }
      if(v.error||v.networkState===3){ if(blobs[i])swapIn(false); else { try{ v.load(); }catch(err){} } }
      st.started=true; st.soundOn=true; v.muted=false; v.defaultMuted=false;
      pauseOthers(i);
      if(v.readyState<3)stage.classList.add('loading');
      tryPlay(v);
      armStall();
      sync();
    }
    st.autoplay=autoplay;
    function toggle(){
      if(v.paused||v.ended){
        st.pendingAutoplay=false;
        if(v.error||v.networkState===3){ if(blobs[i])swapIn(false); else { try{ v.load(); }catch(err){} } }
        if(!st.started){ st.started=true; v.muted=false; v.defaultMuted=false; }
        if(!v.muted){ audioUnlocked=true; st.soundOn=true; }
        pauseOthers(i);
        if(v.readyState<3)stage.classList.add('loading');
        tryPlay(v);
        armStall();
      } else if(v.muted&&!st.soundOn){
        v.muted=false; st.started=true; st.soundOn=true; audioUnlocked=true; sync();
      } else { st.pendingAutoplay=false; v.pause(); }
      sync();
    }
    stage.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      if(e.target&&e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('.vid-snd'))return;
      toggle();
    });
    stage.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); toggle(); }
    });
    snd.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault();
      v.muted=!v.muted;
      if(!v.muted){ st.started=true; audioUnlocked=true; st.soundOn=true; if(v.paused||v.ended){ st.pendingAutoplay=false; pauseOthers(i); if(v.readyState<3)stage.classList.add('loading'); tryPlay(v); armStall(); } }
      sync();
    });
    v.addEventListener('playing',function(){
      clearStall(); stage.classList.remove('loading');
      if(v.currentSrc&&v.currentSrc.indexOf('blob:')!==0)st.directOk=true;
      st.soundOn=!v.muted;
      if(!v.muted)audioUnlocked=true;
      st.pendingAutoplay=false;
      pauseOthers(i); sync();
    });
    v.addEventListener('canplay',function(){
      if(!v.paused){ stage.classList.remove('loading'); return; }
      /* Late data for the slide the user just swiped to: start it now,
         no second press needed. Only for the CURRENT slide, only while
         its arrival-autoplay is still pending. */
      if(st.pendingAutoplay&&i===cur&&audioUnlocked)autoplay();
    });
    v.addEventListener('pause',function(){ clearStall(); stage.classList.remove('loading'); sync(); });
    v.addEventListener('ended',function(){ clearStall(); stage.classList.remove('loading'); sync(); });
    v.addEventListener('error',function(){
      clearStall();
      if(v.getAttribute('src')&&v.getAttribute('src').indexOf('blob:')===0){ stage.classList.remove('loading'); return; }
      rescue(!v.paused);
    });
    v.addEventListener('volumechange',function(){ if(!v.muted&&!v.paused){ st.soundOn=true; audioUnlocked=true; } syncSnd(); });
    syncSnd();
    return st;
  });
  function pauseOthers(except){
    states.forEach(function(o,j){ if(j!==except&&!o.v.paused)o.v.pause(); });
  }
  function pauseAll(){ states.forEach(function(o){ if(!o.v.paused)o.v.pause(); }); }
  /* Prime blob copies one at a time: current slide first, then next, then
     previous — so the slide on screen is tap-ready with sound, and the
     likely next swipe is too, without pulling all 14 files at once. */
  var primeQ=[], priming=false;
  function queuePrime(i){
    /* AUTO-REFRESH FIX, phase 2: metadata, never auto. preload='auto'
       made every slide the user swiped to download its WHOLE file and
       hold the buffer for the rest of the visit — swiping the set could
       pin ~41MB of video in memory, the same kill-and-reload pressure
       as the old blob engine. Metadata fetches the header + first
       frames (posters already carry the still); play() streams the
       rest on tap/swipe exactly as before. */
    if(!canBlob){ if(states[i])states[i].v.preload='metadata'; return; }
    [i,i+1,i-1].forEach(function(j){ if(j>=0&&j<N&&!blobs[j]&&primeQ.indexOf(j)<0)primeQ.push(j); });
    pumpPrime();
  }
  function pumpPrime(){
    if(priming)return;
    var j=primeQ.shift(); if(j===undefined)return;
    if(blobs[j]){ pumpPrime(); return; }
    priming=true;
    fetchBlob(j,function(ok){
      priming=false;
      if(ok){ var s=states[j]; if(s&&s.v.paused&&s.v.currentTime===0&&!s.directOk)s.swapIn(false); }
      pumpPrime();
    });
  }
  function releaseFar(){
    states.forEach(function(s,j){
      /* AUTO-REFRESH FIX, phase 2: slides left behind drop back to
         preload='none' so the browser stops buffering them and can
         evict what it holds. The src is never reset (that churn is
         what the blob-era fix removed); a slide swiped back to simply
         streams again on play. */
      if(Math.abs(j-cur)>1&&s.v.paused)s.v.preload='none';
      if(Math.abs(j-cur)>1&&blobs[j]){
        var old=blobs[j]; delete blobs[j];
        if(s.v.getAttribute('src')===old&&s.v.paused&&s.v.currentTime===0){
          s.v.src=s.src; s.directOk=false; try{ s.v.load(); }catch(e){}
        }
        try{ URL.revokeObjectURL(old); }catch(e){}
      }
    });
  }
  /* PER-VIDEO FRAMES (Taylor's order, superseding the old fixed-frame
     lock): each slide's frame carries its own video's natural aspect
     ratio in CSS (.vid-frame.tall = 320/569 for the portrait reels,
     16/9 for the wide videos), so every video fills its frame edge to
     edge — no bars, no crop, no stretch. fit()'s one job is the
     track height: a flex row is as tall as its tallest slide, so
     without this a wide video would sit at the top of a portrait
     reel's tall empty slide and a change of slide would leave dead
     space (or clip). fit() pins the track height to the CURRENT
     slide's frame height — the CSS height transition smooths the
     change — so each slide is exactly as tall as the video on it.
     The video element itself stays pointer-events:none, so it can
     never be dragged, panned, or moved by touch; a swipe only
     scrolls this track to the next/previous slide. */
  function fit(){
    var s=slides[cur]; if(!s)return;
    var f=s.querySelector('.vid-frame'); if(!f)return;
    var h=f.offsetHeight; if(h>0)track.style.height=h+'px';
  }
  var settleTimer=null;
  function render(){
    tick=false;
    var w=track.clientWidth||1;
    var i=Math.round(track.scrollLeft/w); if(i<0)i=0; if(i>N-1)i=N-1;
    if(i!==cur){
      var prev=cur; cur=i;
      /* leaving a slide stops it — pause everything except the incoming
         slide, so audio can never overlap between slides */
      if(states[prev])states[prev].pendingAutoplay=false;
      pauseOthers(cur);
      queuePrime(cur); releaseFar();
      /* swipe-autoplay: after the first-tap audio unlock, the incoming
         slide starts itself with sound — no play press on slides 2–14
         (and none when swiping back to slide 1 either). Before the
         unlock, slide changes only pause the slide left behind. */
      if(audioUnlocked&&states[cur]){
        states[cur].pendingAutoplay=true;
        states[cur].autoplay();
      }
    }
    fit();
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize',fit);
  track.addEventListener('scroll',function(){
    if(!tick){ tick=true; requestAnimationFrame(render); }
    /* settle pass: once the swipe/snap comes to rest, if the current
       slide is still waiting for its autoplay (data was late), start it */
    if(settleTimer)clearTimeout(settleTimer);
    settleTimer=setTimeout(function(){
      settleTimer=null; render();
      var s=states[cur];
      if(audioUnlocked&&s&&s.pendingAutoplay&&s.v.paused)s.autoplay();
    },260);
  },{passive:true});
  /* a finished touch swipe is itself the moment to re-check autoplay
     for the slide it lands on (render usually beats this to it) */
  track.addEventListener('touchend',function(){
    setTimeout(function(){
      var s=states[cur];
      if(audioUnlocked&&s&&s.pendingAutoplay&&s.v.paused)s.autoplay();
    },320);
  },{passive:true});
  if(typeof setLang==='function'){
    var _prevVid=setLang;
    setLang=function(l){ _prevVid(l); states.forEach(function(o){ o.syncLabels(); }); };
  }
  /* pause when the slideshow leaves the screen — no audio from off-stage */
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
    new IntersectionObserver(function(es2){
      es2.forEach(function(x){ if(!x.isIntersecting)pauseAll(); });
    },{threshold:.12}).observe(track);
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){ if(document.hidden)pauseAll(); });
  /* background suspension: a surface opening over the page (a view or
     sheet stacked above this one) silences the slideshow too */
  document.addEventListener('pv-suspend',function(){ pauseAll(); });
  /* AUTO-REFRESH FIX, phase 2: do NOT prime at page load. This
     slideshow lives inside the Vibes Moments sheet, which is
     display:none until opened — priming slide 1 here buffered a whole
     6.1MB video on every page load for a view the visitor may never
     open. Priming now happens when the sheet actually opens (and on
     slide changes, via render). */
  window.__vidPrime=function(){ queuePrime(cur); };
  render();
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ================= DASHBOARD ASSISTANT — chat inside the owner dashboard ==
   A separate agent from the Ask Vibes site chat. It answers ONLY from
   what this dashboard actually shows: the live LEADS count for this
   visit (inquiries sent from this page's form), the areas' contents,
   and the samples the dashboard itself labels SAMPLE — samples are
   always called samples here, never real records. Anything the
   dashboard does not show (revenue, real bookings, real dates) gets a
   plain "the dashboard doesn't show that" plus a pointer to the
   closest area. Plain, simple language, EN/ES with the site language. */
(function(){
  var msgs=document.getElementById('daMsgs'), input=document.getElementById('daInput'),
      send=document.getElementById('daSend'), title=document.getElementById('daTitle'),
      sub=document.getElementById('daSub'), sec=document.getElementById('daSecLbl');
  if(!msgs||!input||!send)return;
  function es(){ return (typeof LANG!=='undefined'&&LANG==='es'); }
  function A(en,esT){ return es()?esT:en; }
  var greeted=false;
  function greetText(){
    return A("Hi Bryan 👋 I'm your dashboard assistant. I know everything this dashboard shows — New Inquiries, Upcoming Events, LVL Studios Bookings, Messages, Calendar, Clients & Partners, Services & Rentals, Reviews, Photos & Projects and Settings. Ask me in plain words, like \u201CHow many new inquiries do I have?\u201D You can also ask me to do a task, like draft a follow-up or send a reminder, and I will walk it through step by step as a prototype demo — nothing real is sent, booked or changed.",
             "Hola Bryan 👋 Soy tu asistente del panel. Conozco todo lo que muestra este panel: Consultas nuevas, Eventos próximos, Reservas LVL Studios, Mensajes, Calendario, Clientes y socios, Servicios y alquileres, Reseñas, Fotos y proyectos y Ajustes. Pregúntame en palabras simples, como \u00AB¿Cuántas consultas nuevas tengo?\u00BB También puedes pedirme una tarea, como redactar un seguimiento o enviar un recordatorio, y la muestro paso a paso como demostración de prototipo: nada real se envía, reserva ni cambia.");
  }
  function add(text,who){
    var d=document.createElement('div');
    d.className='msg '+(who||'bot'); d.textContent=text;
    msgs.appendChild(d); msgs.scrollTop=msgs.scrollHeight;
    return d;
  }
  function answer(qRaw){
    var s=' '+String(qRaw||'').toLowerCase()+' ', n=(typeof LEADS!=='undefined')?LEADS.length:0;
    if(/(send|draft|remind|cancel|reschedul|delete|remove|follow.?up|book a |book the |pay |charge )/.test(s)) return A(
      "Prototype demo — I can't really send, book, pay or change anything yet: this dashboard is a demo and no service is connected, so nothing you ask me here goes out for real. Here is how I would handle that task, step by step, with the sample data on this dashboard: 1) I draft the message from the templates in Messages and Support. 2) I show you the full preview before anything happens. 3) In the live version you would tap confirm, and only then would it send. For now, tap Messages and Support or New Inquiries above to see the same drafts and samples. Nothing was sent, booked or changed.",
      "Demostración de prototipo: todavía no puedo enviar, reservar, pagar ni cambiar nada de verdad: este panel es una demo y no hay ningún servicio conectado, así que nada de lo que pidas aquí sale de verdad. Así manejaría esa tarea, paso a paso, con los datos de ejemplo de este panel: 1) Redacto el mensaje desde las plantillas de Mensajes y soporte. 2) Te muestro la vista previa completa antes de que pase algo. 3) En la versión en vivo tocarías confirmar, y solo entonces se enviaría. Por ahora, toca Mensajes y soporte o Consultas nuevas arriba para ver los mismos borradores y ejemplos. Nada se envió, reservó ni cambió.");
    if(/lvl|studio|estudio/.test(s)) return A(
      "LVL Studios Bookings shows 2 bookings, and both are labeled SAMPLE: a \u201CFashion show hold\u201D and a \u201CPodcast studio day\u201D. They are examples of how a booking looks — not real bookings. The area also shows the space itself: 14,440 square feet, holds 700 people, 12-foot ceilings, in Jersey City. LVL prices are quoted per event — there is no price list in the dashboard.",
      "Reservas LVL Studios muestra 2 reservas, y ambas están marcadas SAMPLE (ejemplo): un \u00ABFashion show hold\u00BB y un \u00ABPodcast studio day\u00BB. Son ejemplos de cómo se ve una reserva, no reservas reales. El área también muestra el espacio: 14,440 pies², capacidad para 700 personas, techos de 12 pies, en Jersey City. Los precios de LVL se cotizan por evento: no hay lista de precios en el panel.");
    if(/inquir|lead|form|consulta|formulario/.test(s)) return n?A(
      "You have "+n+" new "+(n===1?"inquiry":"inquiries")+" from this page's form in this visit. The latest is from "+LEADS[0].name+" ("+LEADS[0].type+", "+LEADS[0].when+"). Tap \u201CNew Inquiries\u201D above to read "+(n===1?"it":"them")+". Heads up: inquiries stay for this visit only — this demo dashboard does not keep them after you leave the page.",
      "Tienes "+n+" "+(n===1?"consulta nueva":"consultas nuevas")+" del formulario de esta página en esta visita. La más reciente es de "+LEADS[0].name+" ("+LEADS[0].type+", "+LEADS[0].when+"). Toca \u00ABConsultas nuevas\u00BB arriba para leerla"+(n===1?"":"s")+". Ojo: las consultas quedan solo por esta visita: este panel de demostración no las guarda cuando sales de la página."):A(
      "No new inquiries yet in this visit. When someone sends the booking form on this page, it shows up here right away — for this visit only. Inside \u201CNew Inquiries\u201D you will also see 2 examples labeled SAMPLE (a corporate gala inquiry and a Sweet 16 inquiry) so you can see how a real one will look. Samples are examples, not real inquiries.",
      "Todavía no hay consultas nuevas en esta visita. Cuando alguien envía el formulario de reserva de esta página, aparece aquí enseguida, solo por esta visita. Dentro de \u00ABConsultas nuevas\u00BB también verás 2 ejemplos marcados SAMPLE (una consulta de gala corporativa y una de Sweet 16) para que veas cómo se verá una real. Los ejemplos no son consultas reales.");
    if(/event|upcoming|booking|evento|reserva/.test(s)) return A(
      "Upcoming Events shows 2 events, and both are labeled SAMPLE: a \u201CHoliday gala production\u201D and a \u201CBrand activation weekend\u201D. They are examples, not real bookings — the dashboard does not show real bookings or real dates. In real life, bookings are confirmed by email (info@premierevibes.com) and phone (347-709-6712).",
      "Eventos próximos muestra 2 eventos, y ambos están marcados SAMPLE (ejemplo): una \u00ABHoliday gala production\u00BB y un \u00ABBrand activation weekend\u00BB. Son ejemplos, no reservas reales: el panel no muestra reservas ni fechas reales. En la vida real, las reservas se confirman por correo (info@premierevibes.com) y teléfono (347-709-6712).");
    if(/message|dm|instagram|mensaje|correo/.test(s)) return A(
      "Messages shows 2 messages, and both are labeled SAMPLE: an Instagram direct message asking \u201CDo you have a 360 photobooth for a Sweet 16?\u201D and an email saying \u201CWe need Audio/Visual for a 300-person conference.\u201D They are examples, not real messages. Your real channels are info@premierevibes.com, Instagram @PremiereVibes and 347-709-6712.",
      "Mensajes muestra 2 mensajes, y ambos están marcados SAMPLE (ejemplo): un mensaje directo de Instagram que pregunta \u00AB¿Tienen photobooth 360 para un Sweet 16?\u00BB y un correo que dice \u00ABNecesitamos Audio/Visual para una conferencia de 300 personas\u00BB. Son ejemplos, no mensajes reales. Tus canales reales son info@premierevibes.com, Instagram @PremiereVibes y 347-709-6712.");
    if(/calendar|calendario|schedule|agenda/.test(s)){
      var now=new Date(), names=A(['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'],['enero','febrero','marzo','abril','mayo','junio','julio','agosto','septiembre','octubre','noviembre','diciembre']);
      return A(
        "The Calendar shows "+names[now.getMonth()]+" "+now.getFullYear()+". Today is outlined. The gold dots are sample holds — there is 1 example labeled SAMPLE, a \u201CProduction hold\u201D. The dashboard does not show real event dates, so I can't tell you a real date from here.",
        "El Calendario muestra "+names[now.getMonth()]+" de "+now.getFullYear()+". Hoy está marcado. Los puntos dorados son reservas de ejemplo: hay 1 ejemplo marcado SAMPLE, un \u00ABProduction hold\u00BB. El panel no muestra fechas reales de eventos, así que no puedo darte una fecha real desde aquí.");
    }
    if(/client|partner|brand|cliente|socio|marca/.test(s)) return A(
      "Clients & Partners shows the verified brands from the premierevibes.com logo wall — "+BRANDS.length+" of them, including "+BRANDS.slice(0,6).join(', ')+". It also notes the New York Marriott Marquis, which lists Bryan Kuan as a creative partner on its \u201CMarquis in Bloom\u201D page. It does not show a private client list, contacts or contracts.",
      "Clientes y socios muestra las marcas verificadas del muro de logos de premierevibes.com: "+BRANDS.length+" en total, incluyendo "+BRANDS.slice(0,6).join(', ')+". También menciona el New York Marriott Marquis, que lista a Bryan Kuan como socio creativo en su página \u00ABMarquis in Bloom\u00BB. No muestra lista privada de clientes, contactos ni contratos.");
    if(/service|rent|servicio|alquiler/.test(s)) return A(
      "Services & Rentals lists all 9 departments: "+SERVICES.map(function(x){return x.name;}).join(' · ')+". Its star rentals are LED dance floors, custom LED walls, CO2 jets + guns, sparkulars, LED mobile billboards, cigar rollers and love seats + sweetheart chairs. Prices are not shown — every event is quoted on its own.",
      "Servicios y alquileres lista los 9 departamentos: "+SERVICES.map(function(x){return x.name;}).join(' · ')+". Sus alquileres estrella son pistas de baile LED, muros LED personalizados, jets y pistolas de CO2, sparkulars, vallas LED móviles, torcedores de puros y love seats + sillas sweetheart. Los precios no se muestran: cada evento se cotiza por separado.");
    if(/review|rating|star|reseña|resena|estrella|opinion/.test(s)) return A(
      "Reviews shows 5.0 stars: 151 Google reviews, every one 5-star (Birdeye shows 157 in a different snapshot). The dashboard lists the first 4 reviewers: Juneteenth Celebration, Pgabo22, Nikita Dolgachev and Miguel Antuna, with their full words — for example Juneteenth Celebration calls Premiere Vibes \u201Can amazing team to work with from idea to reality\u201D. Tap \u201CReviews\u201D above to read them.",
      "Reseñas muestra 5.0 estrellas: 151 reseñas de Google, todas de 5 estrellas (Birdeye muestra 157 en otra captura). El panel lista los primeros 4 reseñadores: Juneteenth Celebration, Pgabo22, Nikita Dolgachev y Miguel Antuna, con sus palabras completas; por ejemplo, Juneteenth Celebration llama a Premiere Vibes \u00ABun equipo increíble para trabajar, de la idea a la realidad\u00BB. Toca \u00ABReseñas\u00BB arriba para leerlas.");
    if(/photo|project|foto|proyecto|work|trabajo/.test(s)) return A(
      "Photos & Projects lists verified recent productions: "+PROJECTS.map(function(p){return p[0];}).join(' · ')+". It also lists the community work, like the Turkey Drive and the Dear Summer Block Party. Tap \u201CPhotos & Projects\u201D above for the details of each one.",
      "Fotos y proyectos lista producciones recientes verificadas: "+PROJECTS.map(function(p){return p[0];}).join(' · ')+". También lista el trabajo comunitario, como el Turkey Drive y el Dear Summer Block Party. Toca \u00ABFotos y proyectos\u00BB arriba para ver el detalle de cada uno.");
    if(/setting|config|ajuste|language|idioma|toggle|interruptor/.test(s)) return A(
      "Settings has 3 switches: Ask Vibes (the bottom-right chat for visitors) on or off, the site language (EN / ES, applies to the whole site), and Pause for the scrolling brand wall. It also shows your public contact: info@premierevibes.com · +1 (347) 709-6712 · @PremiereVibes. This is a demo preview, so the switches only change this page.",
      "Ajustes tiene 3 interruptores: Ask Vibes (el chat de abajo a la derecha para visitantes) activado o desactivado, el idioma del sitio (EN / ES, aplica a todo el sitio) y Pausa para el muro de marcas en movimiento. También muestra tu contacto público: info@premierevibes.com · +1 (347) 709-6712 · @PremiereVibes. Esto es una vista previa de demostración, así que los interruptores solo cambian esta página.");
    if(/today|glance|summary|hoy|resumen|overview/.test(s)) return A(
      "Today at a glance: "+n+" new "+(n===1?"inquiry":"inquiries")+" in this visit, 2 sample upcoming events, and 2 sample messages. Only the inquiries are live for this visit — the events and messages cards are counting the labeled samples inside their areas.",
      "Hoy de un vistazo: "+n+" "+(n===1?"consulta nueva":"consultas nuevas")+" en esta visita, 2 eventos próximos de ejemplo y 2 mensajes de ejemplo. Solo las consultas son en vivo por esta visita: las tarjetas de eventos y mensajes cuentan los ejemplos marcados dentro de sus áreas.");
    if(/price|cost|revenue|money|precio|cuesta|dinero|ingreso|sales|venta/.test(s)) return A(
      "The dashboard doesn't show prices, revenue or sales, so I won't guess. What it does show: every event is quoted on its own, and LVL Studios rates are quoted per event — see \u201CLVL Studios Bookings\u201D and \u201CServices & Rentals\u201D above.",
      "El panel no muestra precios, ingresos ni ventas, así que no voy a adivinar. Lo que sí muestra: cada evento se cotiza por separado, y las tarifas de LVL Studios se cotizan por evento; mira \u00ABReservas LVL Studios\u00BB y \u00ABServicios y alquileres\u00BB arriba.");
    if(/^(hi|hey|hello|hola|yo|sup)\b|help|ayuda|what can you|qué puedes|que puedes/.test(s)) return greetText();
    return A(
      "The dashboard doesn't show that, so I won't guess. I can answer about: New Inquiries, Upcoming Events, LVL Studios Bookings, Messages, Calendar, Clients & Partners, Services & Rentals, Reviews, Photos & Projects, Settings, and the \u201CToday at a glance\u201D counts. Try one of those — or tap the area above to see it directly.",
      "El panel no muestra eso, así que no voy a adivinar. Puedo responder sobre: Consultas nuevas, Eventos próximos, Reservas LVL Studios, Mensajes, Calendario, Clientes y socios, Servicios y alquileres, Reseñas, Fotos y proyectos, Ajustes y los conteos de \u00ABHoy de un vistazo\u00BB. Prueba con uno de esos, o toca el área arriba para verla directamente.");
  }
  function chrome(){
    if(title)title.textContent=A('Dashboard Assistant','Asistente del panel');
    if(sub)sub.textContent=A('Knows every area of this dashboard — ask in plain words','Conoce cada área de este panel: pregunta en palabras simples');
    if(sec)sec.textContent=A('Dashboard assistant','Asistente del panel');
    var fabEl=document.getElementById('daFab'); if(fabEl)fabEl.setAttribute('aria-label',A('Open dashboard assistant','Abrir el asistente del panel'));
    input.placeholder=A('Ask about inquiries, events, reviews…','Pregunta por consultas, eventos, reseñas…');
    send.setAttribute('aria-label',A('Send question','Enviar pregunta'));
  }
  function submit(){
    var q=input.value.trim(); if(!q)return;
    input.value='';
    add(q,'user');
    add(answer(q),'bot');
  }
  send.addEventListener('click',submit);
  input.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Enter'){ e.preventDefault(); submit(); } });
  /* floating bubble — the assistant now lives in a fixed bottom-right
     bubble on the dashboard (the same pattern as the Ask Vibes site
     chat): tapping the bubble toggles the compact panel, the ✕ in the
     panel head closes it. Chat behaviour itself is unchanged. */
  var daPanel=document.getElementById('dashAgent'),
      daFab=document.getElementById('daFab'),
      daX=document.getElementById('daClose');
  function setDa(open){
    if(!daPanel)return;
    daPanel.classList.toggle('open',!!open);
    if(daFab)daFab.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open?'true':'false');
    if(open)msgs.scrollTop=msgs.scrollHeight;
    /* same pop-up contract as Ask Vibes: never focus the input on open
       (no keyboard until the user taps inside it); blur it on close so
       no keyboard is left open over the dashboard. */
    if(!open&&input&&input.blur)input.blur();
  }
  if(daFab)daFab.addEventListener('click',function(){ setDa(!daPanel.classList.contains('open')); });
  if(daX)daX.addEventListener('click',function(){ setDa(false); });
  chrome();
  add(greetText(),'bot'); greeted=true;
  if(typeof setLang==='function'){
    var _prevDa=setLang;
    setLang=function(l){ _prevDa(l); chrome(); if(greeted&&msgs.children.length===1)msgs.children[0].textContent=greetText(); };
  }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ================= GOOGLE REVIEWS — clean banner + slideshow ========
   Renders the site's existing REVIEWS set (50 Google reviews) into a
   swipe SLIDESHOW under the clean gold banner head (gold stars, 5.0,
   151 Google reviews) — NOT a drop-down list (Taylor's correction).
   Review text, names and dates come straight from REVIEWS — verbatim,
   never reworded. COLLAPSED by default: banner head only, with a
   "See more" toggle. Tapping it opens the slideshow in place: one
   complete review at a time, full-width, swipe to move to the next,
   in order, starting with Juneteenth Celebration; tapping "Show
   less" collapses back to the banner only. Each slide shows name,
   5 gold stars and date - Google. Reviews with verified text show
   it clamped to two lines, with their own Read more / Show less
   opening the full verbatim text in place; reviews without text
   show name / stars / date only — no invented words and no
   per-review Google link (none was ever verified). No arrows and
   no dots — swipe only. Moving to another slide collapses any open
   Read more, and collapsing the slideshow resets it to the first
   slide with every Read more closed. */
(function(){
  var box=document.getElementById('gReviews');
  if(!box||typeof REVIEWS==='undefined')return;
  var track=document.getElementById('grevTrack'), drop=document.getElementById('grevDrop'),
      toggle=document.getElementById('grevToggle'), toggleLbl=document.getElementById('grevToggleLbl'),
      headLbl=document.getElementById('grevHeadLbl'), swipeLbl=document.getElementById('grevSwipeLbl');
  var open=false, curIdx=0, scrollRaf=0;
  function es(){ return (typeof LANG!=='undefined'&&LANG==='es'); }
  function renderSlides(){
    track.innerHTML=REVIEWS.map(function(r,i){
      var body='';
      if(r.q){
        body='<p class="grev-quote" data-grevq="'+i+'">\u201C'+r.q+'\u201D</p>';
        if(r.q.length>75){
          body+='<button type="button" class="grev-more" data-grevmore="'+i+'" aria-expanded="false">'
            +(es()?'Leer más':'Read more')+' <span class="gm-chev" aria-hidden="true">▾</span></button>';
        }
      }
      return '<div class="grev-slide"><div class="grev-meta"><div class="grev-name">'+r.n+'</div>'
        +'<div class="grev-when">'+r.d+' · Google</div></div>'
        +'<div class="grev-item-stars" aria-label="5 stars">★★★★★</div>'+body+'</div>';
    }).join('');
  }
  /* per-review partial <-> full: tapping the quote or its Read more
     control opens the full verbatim quote in place, on that slide
     only; tapping again collapses it back to the two-line partial. */
  function setExpanded(slide,exp){
    if(!slide)return;
    slide.classList.toggle('exp',exp);
    var btn=slide.querySelector('.grev-more');
    if(btn){
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',exp?'true':'false');
      btn.innerHTML=(exp?(es()?'Ver menos':'Show less'):(es()?'Leer más':'Read more'))
        +' <span class="gm-chev" aria-hidden="true">▾</span>';
    }
  }
  function collapseAll(){
    var slides=track.querySelectorAll('.grev-slide.exp');
    for(var i=0;i<slides.length;i++)setExpanded(slides[i],false);
  }
  track.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var t=e.target&&e.target.closest?e.target.closest('[data-grevmore],[data-grevq]'):null;
    if(!t)return;
    var slide=t.closest?t.closest('.grev-slide'):null;
    if(!slide||!slide.querySelector('.grev-more'))return;
    setExpanded(slide,!slide.classList.contains('exp'));
  });
  /* slide-change watch: once the swipe settles on a different slide,
     any open Read more collapses (as before). The current index is
     derived from the track's own scroll position — one slide is
     exactly one track width. */
  function currentIndex(){
    var w=track.clientWidth||1;
    return Math.max(0,Math.min(REVIEWS.length-1,Math.round(track.scrollLeft/w)));
  }
  track.addEventListener('scroll',function(){
    if(scrollRaf)return;
    scrollRaf=requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      scrollRaf=0;
      var idx=currentIndex();
      if(idx!==curIdx){ curIdx=idx; collapseAll(); }
    });
  },{passive:true});
  function goToFirst(){
    curIdx=0;
    track.scrollLeft=0;
  }
  function setOpen(next){
    open=next;
    collapseAll();
    box.classList.toggle('open',open);
    drop.hidden=!open;
    if(open){ goToFirst(); }
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open?'true':'false');
    toggleLbl.textContent=open?(es()?'Ver menos':'Show less'):(es()?'Ver más':'See more');
  }
  toggle.addEventListener('click',function(){ setOpen(!open); });
  function renderAll(){
    var keepIdx=open?currentIndex():0;
    renderSlides();
    curIdx=keepIdx;
    if(open&&keepIdx>0){ track.scrollLeft=keepIdx*(track.clientWidth||0); }
    if(headLbl)headLbl.textContent=es()?'151 reseñas de Google':'151 Google reviews';
    if(swipeLbl)swipeLbl.textContent=es()?'Desliza':'Swipe';
    toggleLbl.textContent=open?(es()?'Ver menos':'Show less'):(es()?'Ver más':'See more');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open?'true':'false');
  }
  if(typeof setLang==='function'){
    var _prevGrev=setLang;
    setLang=function(l){ _prevGrev(l); renderAll(); };
  }
  renderAll();
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ===== HERO BADGE → REVIEWS POPUP =====
   Tapping the gold "5 star google reviews" badge in the hero opens the
   small #revPop box with a slideshow of ALL reviews from the saved
   REVIEWS set — same order as the old banner slideshow (Juneteenth
   Celebration first), one complete review at a time, swipe to move,
   Read more / Show less expanding the full verified text in place on
   that slide only, name / stars / date only where no verified text
   exists (nothing invented). Moving to another slide collapses any
   open Read more; opening the box always starts at the first review;
   the X, the backdrop and Escape close it back to the hero. Reviewer
   names, dates and quotes stay verbatim in both languages — only the
   box chrome (header label, swipe hint, counter, Read more, close
   label) translates EN/ES. Uses the shared reference-counted scroll
   lock so the page behind never moves while the box is open. */
(function(){
  var badge=document.getElementById('heroBadgeBtn'),
      pop=document.getElementById('revPop'),
      track=document.getElementById('revPopTrack'),
      count=document.getElementById('revPopCount'),
      headLbl=document.getElementById('revPopLbl'),
      swipeLbl=document.getElementById('revPopSwipeLbl'),
      closeBtn=document.getElementById('revPopX');
  if(!badge||!pop||!track||typeof REVIEWS==='undefined')return;
  var isOpen=false, curIdx=0, scrollRaf=0;
  function es(){ return (typeof LANG!=='undefined'&&LANG==='es'); }
  function renderSlides(){
    track.innerHTML=REVIEWS.map(function(r,i){
      var body='';
      if(r.q){
        body='<p class="grev-quote" data-rpopq="'+i+'">\u201C'+r.q+'\u201D</p>';
        if(r.q.length>75){
          body+='<button type="button" class="grev-more" data-rpopmore="'+i+'" aria-expanded="false">'
            +(es()?'Leer más':'Read more')+' <span class="gm-chev" aria-hidden="true">▾</span></button>';
        }
      }
      return '<div class="grev-slide"><div class="grev-meta"><div class="grev-name">'+r.n+'</div>'
