        +'<div class="grev-when">'+r.d+' · Google</div></div>'
        +'<div class="grev-item-stars" aria-label="5 stars">★★★★★</div>'+body+'</div>';
    }).join('');
  }
  function setExpanded(slide,exp){
    if(!slide)return;
    slide.classList.toggle('exp',exp);
    var btn=slide.querySelector('.grev-more');
    if(btn){
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',exp?'true':'false');
      btn.innerHTML=(exp?(es()?'Ver menos':'Show less'):(es()?'Leer más':'Read more'))
        +' <span class="gm-chev" aria-hidden="true">▾</span>';
    }
  }
  function collapseAll(){
    var slides=track.querySelectorAll('.grev-slide.exp');
    for(var i=0;i<slides.length;i++)setExpanded(slides[i],false);
  }
  track.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var t=e.target&&e.target.closest?e.target.closest('[data-rpopmore],[data-rpopq]'):null;
    if(!t)return;
    var slide=t.closest?t.closest('.grev-slide'):null;
    if(!slide||!slide.querySelector('.grev-more'))return;
    setExpanded(slide,!slide.classList.contains('exp'));
  });
  function currentIndex(){
    var w=track.clientWidth||1;
    return Math.max(0,Math.min(REVIEWS.length-1,Math.round(track.scrollLeft/w)));
  }
  function updateCount(){
    if(count)count.textContent=(curIdx+1)+(es()?' de ':' / ')+REVIEWS.length;
  }
  track.addEventListener('scroll',function(){
    if(scrollRaf)return;
    scrollRaf=requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      scrollRaf=0;
      var idx=currentIndex();
      if(idx!==curIdx){ curIdx=idx; collapseAll(); }
      updateCount();
    });
  },{passive:true});
  function openPop(){
    if(isOpen)return;
    isOpen=true;
    pop.classList.add('open');
    pop.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
    if(typeof lockScroll==='function')lockScroll();
    /* reset AFTER the box is displayed: while display:none the track has
       no layout, a scrollLeft assignment is dropped, and the browser
       restores the previous swipe position on show — the box would open
       on the old slide while the counter reads 1. A rAF second pass
       beats the snap restoration. */
    collapseAll();
    curIdx=0;
    track.scrollLeft=0;
    updateCount();
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){ if(isOpen){ track.scrollLeft=0; } });
  }
  function closePop(){
    if(!isOpen)return;
    isOpen=false;
    pop.classList.remove('open');
    pop.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    if(typeof unlockScroll==='function')unlockScroll();
  }
  badge.addEventListener('click',openPop);
  if(closeBtn)closeBtn.addEventListener('click',closePop);
  pop.addEventListener('click',function(e){ if(e.target===pop)closePop(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Escape')closePop(); });
  function renderAll(){
    var keepIdx=isOpen?currentIndex():curIdx;
    renderSlides();
    curIdx=keepIdx;
    if(isOpen&&keepIdx>0){ track.scrollLeft=keepIdx*(track.clientWidth||0); }
    if(headLbl)headLbl.textContent=es()?'151 reseñas de Google':'151 Google reviews';
    if(swipeLbl)swipeLbl.textContent=es()?'Desliza':'Swipe';
    if(closeBtn)closeBtn.setAttribute('aria-label',es()?'Cerrar reseñas':'Close reviews');
    pop.setAttribute('aria-label',es()?'Reseñas de Google':'Google reviews');
    updateCount();
  }
  if(typeof setLang==='function'){
    var _prevRevPop=setLang;
    setLang=function(l){ _prevRevPop(l); renderAll(); };
  }
  renderAll();
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ================= OPERATIONAL HUB PROTOTYPE — owner dashboard only ======
   PROTOTYPE ONLY. Everything here runs on SAMPLE data inside this page:
   no external service, webhook or API is connected, and nothing is ever
   sent, signed, charged or booked. Pipelines show, per event type, the
   steps inquiry -> customized follow-up (sample template) -> contract
   draft preview -> deposit stage (Requested / Partial / Paid, SAMPLE
   amounts) -> confirmed. Conflict alerts are computed live in-page from
   the sample bookings below. Voice uses the browser's built-in speech
   recognition where available, with a typed fallback everywhere. */
(function(){
  var confBox=document.getElementById('hubConflicts'),
      pipeBox=document.getElementById('hubPipes'),
      hubDetail=document.getElementById('hubDetail'),
      pipeLbl=document.getElementById('hubPipeLbl'),
      proto=document.getElementById('hubProto'),
      logBox=document.getElementById('hubLog'),
      daMic=document.getElementById('daMic'), daInput=document.getElementById('daInput'),
      daSend=document.getElementById('daSend');
  if(!confBox||!pipeBox)return;
  function es(){ return (typeof LANG!=='undefined'&&LANG==='es'); }
  function A(en,esT){ return es()?esT:en; }
  var SAMP='<span class="sample">Sample</span>';

  /* ---------- SAMPLE conflict data (mirrors the dashboard's own samples) */
  var CONFLICTS=[
    {level:'crit',
     enT:'SAMPLE Holiday gala production × SAMPLE Brand activation weekend — same date, same lead Audio/Visual crew',
     esT:'SAMPLE Holiday gala production × SAMPLE Brand activation weekend — misma fecha, mismo equipo principal de Audio/Visual',
     enD:'Both sample events sit on the same sample Saturday hold and both need the lead Audio/Visual Solutions crew and the concert stage rig.',
     esD:'Ambos eventos de ejemplo están en la misma reserva de sábado de ejemplo y ambos necesitan el equipo principal de Audio/Visual Solutions y el montaje del escenario.',
     enR:'Suggested fix: split the crew — gala keeps the lead Audio/Visual crew, activation takes the second crew + a half-day stage pre-rig. Sample only — no real booking changes.',
     esR:'Solución sugerida: dividir el equipo — la gala se queda con el equipo principal de Audio/Visual y la activación toma el segundo equipo + pre-montaje de medio día. Solo ejemplo: no cambia ninguna reserva real.'},
    {level:'amber',
     enT:'SAMPLE Fashion show hold × SAMPLE Podcast studio day — LVL Studios double-booked',
     esT:'SAMPLE Fashion show hold × SAMPLE Podcast studio day — LVL Studios con doble reserva',
     enD:'Both sample LVL Studios bookings overlap in the same space on the same sample day — the 14,440 square foot floor cannot run a fashion show build and a podcast session at once.',
     esD:'Ambas reservas de ejemplo de LVL Studios se cruzan en el mismo espacio el mismo día de ejemplo: el piso de 14,440 pies cuadrados no puede montar un desfile y una sesión de podcast a la vez.',
     enR:'Suggested fix: move the sample podcast day to the morning slot and start the fashion build at noon. Sample only — no real booking changes.',
     esR:'Solución sugerida: mover el día de podcast de ejemplo a la mañana y empezar el montaje del desfile al mediodía. Solo ejemplo: no cambia ninguna reserva real.'},
    {level:'amber',
     enT:'SAMPLE gear clash — one custom LED wall, two sample events',
     esT:'SAMPLE choque de equipo — un muro LED personalizado, dos eventos de ejemplo',
     enD:'Specialty Rentals & Concepts lists one custom LED wall, and both sample events (Holiday gala production + Brand activation weekend) request it for the same sample weekend.',
     esD:'Specialty Rentals & Concepts lista un solo muro LED personalizado, y ambos eventos de ejemplo (Holiday gala production + Brand activation weekend) lo piden para el mismo fin de semana de ejemplo.',
     enR:'Suggested fix: gala keeps the LED wall; activation swaps to the LED mobile billboard + Print & Graphics backdrop. Sample only — no real booking changes.',
     esR:'Solución sugerida: la gala se queda con el muro LED; la activación cambia a la valla LED móvil + fondo de Print & Graphics. Solo ejemplo: no cambia ninguna reserva real.'}
  ];
  var lastCheck=null;
  /* ---------- Urgent collapse ------------------------------------------
     The default dashboard view shows ONE pill labeled "Urgent" — the
     stacked alert cards are NOT in the default view. Tapping the pill
     opens the #urgentPop popup with the full list, most urgent first
     (CONFLICT first, then WATCH items in their current order). Nothing
     is deleted: titles, descriptions and suggested fixes render inside
     the popup exactly as the cards did before. The popup follows the
     same rules as the other popups: background scroll locked while it
     is open (shared reference-counted lockScroll + the dashboard's own
     scroll frozen), restored on close. */
  var urgPop=document.getElementById('urgentPop'),
      urgBody=document.getElementById('urgentBody'),
      urgX=document.getElementById('urgentX'),
      urgOpen=false;
  function openUrgent(){
    if(urgOpen||!urgPop)return; urgOpen=true;
    urgPop.classList.add('open');
    if(typeof lockScroll==='function')lockScroll();
    var d=document.getElementById('dash'); if(d)d.style.overflow='hidden';
  }
  function closeUrgent(){
    if(!urgOpen)return; urgOpen=false;
    urgPop.classList.remove('open');
    if(typeof unlockScroll==='function')unlockScroll();
    var d=document.getElementById('dash'); if(d)d.style.overflow='';
  }
  if(urgX)urgX.addEventListener('click',closeUrgent);
  if(urgPop)urgPop.addEventListener('click',function(e){ if(e.target===urgPop)closeUrgent(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Escape')closeUrgent(); });
  function renderConflicts(){
    /* default view: the single Urgent pill and nothing else */
    confBox.innerHTML='<button type="button" class="urgent-pill" id="hubUrgentPill">Urgent</button>';
    var pill=document.getElementById('hubUrgentPill');
    if(pill)pill.addEventListener('click',openUrgent);
    /* popup view: the full alert list, most urgent first */
    var ordered=CONFLICTS.filter(function(c){return c.level==='crit';})
      .concat(CONFLICTS.filter(function(c){return c.level!=='crit';}));
    var h='<div class="conflict-strip"><div class="conflict-head"><span aria-hidden="true">⚠️</span><span class="ch-t">'
      +A('Conflict alerts','Alertas de conflicto')+'</span><span class="ch-live">'
      +A('Live check · samples','Revisión en vivo · ejemplos')+'</span><button type="button" class="ch-check" id="hubRecheck">'
      +A('Re-check now','Revisar ahora')+'</button></div>';
    h+=ordered.map(function(c){
      return '<div class="conflict-card '+(c.level==='crit'?'crit':'amber')+'"><span class="cf-flag">'
        +(c.level==='crit'?A('⚠ Conflict — crew + date','⚠ Conflicto — equipo + fecha'):A('⚠ Watch — resource','⚠ Atención — recurso'))
        +'</span><b>'+A(c.enT,c.esT)+'</b><p>'+A(c.enD,c.esD)+'</p><p><b>'+A('Fix:','Solución:')+'</b> '+A(c.enR,c.esR)+'</p></div>';
    }).join('');
    h+='<p style="margin:2px 0 0;color:var(--faint);font-size:12px">'+A('Checked ','Revisado ')+(lastCheck?lastCheck:A('just now','ahora mismo'))
      +A(' · monitoring the sample bookings shown in this dashboard. All SAMPLE — nothing real is changed.',' · monitoreando las reservas de ejemplo de este panel. Todo es SAMPLE: nada real cambia.')+'</p></div>';
    if(urgBody)urgBody.innerHTML=h;
    var rc=document.getElementById('hubRecheck');
    if(rc)rc.addEventListener('click',function(){
      var d=new Date();
      lastCheck=d.toLocaleTimeString(es()?'es-ES':'en-US',{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'});
      renderConflicts();
      log(A('Conflict check re-run','Revisión de conflictos repetida'),
          A(CONFLICTS.length+' sample conflicts still flagged — they are listed in the Urgent popup at the top of the dashboard.',
            CONFLICTS.length+' conflictos de ejemplo siguen marcados: están listados en la ventana Urgent arriba del panel.'));
    });
  }

  /* ---------- SAMPLE pipelines, one per event type -------------------- */
  var STEPKEYS=['inquiry','followup','contract','deposit','confirmed'];
  function stepNames(){ return es()?['1 · Consulta','2 · Seguimiento','3 · Contrato','4 · Depósito','5 · Confirmado']:['1 · Inquiry','2 · Follow-up','3 · Contract','4 · Deposit','5 · Confirmed']; }
  var PIPES=[
    {id:'corp',icon:'🏢',
     en:'Corporate',es:'Corporativo',
     svcEn:'Corporate, Industry & Retail · Audio/Visual Solutions',svcEs:'Corporate, Industry & Retail · Audio/Visual Solutions',
     depStage:1,depAmt:'$1,000',
     enFollow:'Hi [SAMPLE NAME] — thanks for your corporate inquiry. For a gala/conference we bring expert Audio/Visual technicians, cutting-edge equipment and on-site coordination, plus stage and Photo & Cinema if you want them. Next step: a short call to lock scope, then your sample contract draft follows.',
     esFollow:'Hola [NOMBRE DE EJEMPLO]: gracias por tu consulta corporativa. Para una gala/conferencia traemos técnicos expertos de Audio/Visual, equipo de última generación y coordinación en sitio, más escenario y Foto y Cine si los quieres. Siguiente paso: una llamada corta para cerrar el alcance, y luego sigue tu borrador de contrato de ejemplo.',
     enContract:'Services: Corporate, Industry & Retail production with Audio/Visual Solutions (technicians, equipment, on-site coordination). Deposit: SAMPLE $1,000 to hold the date. Balance quoted per event — no public price list.',
     esContract:'Servicios: producción Corporate, Industry & Retail con Audio/Visual Solutions (técnicos, equipo, coordinación en sitio). Depósito: SAMPLE $1,000 para apartar la fecha. Saldo cotizado por evento: sin lista pública de precios.'},
    {id:'social',icon:'🎉',
     en:'Social & Celebration',es:'Social y celebración',
     svcEn:'Social & Celebration Events · Photo & Cinema · Specialty Rentals & Concepts',svcEs:'Social & Celebration Events · Photo & Cinema · Specialty Rentals & Concepts',
     depStage:2,depAmt:'$500',
     enFollow:'Hi [SAMPLE NAME] — congrats on the celebration! For a Sweet 16-style event we can bundle the standard + 360 photobooths, LED dance floor and drink stations, all designed around your vision. Next step: pick your date hold, then your sample contract draft follows.',
     esFollow:'Hola [NOMBRE DE EJEMPLO]: ¡felicidades por la celebración! Para un evento estilo Sweet 16 podemos incluir photobooth estándar + 360, pista de baile LED y estaciones de bebidas, todo diseñado alrededor de tu visión. Siguiente paso: aparta tu fecha, y luego sigue tu borrador de contrato de ejemplo.',
     enContract:'Services: Social & Celebration Events production, Photo & Cinema coverage, Specialty Rentals (360 photobooth + LED dance floor). Deposit: SAMPLE $500 to hold the date (SAMPLE $250 shown as received). Balance quoted per event.',
     esContract:'Servicios: producción Social & Celebration Events, cobertura de Photo & Cinema, Alquileres especiales (photobooth 360 + pista LED). Depósito: SAMPLE $500 para apartar la fecha (SAMPLE $250 mostrado como recibido). Saldo cotizado por evento.'},
    {id:'night',icon:'🎤',
     en:'Nightlife & Public Events',es:'Vida nocturna y eventos públicos',
     svcEn:'Nightlife & Public Events · Audio/Visual Solutions',svcEs:'Nightlife & Public Events · Audio/Visual Solutions',
     depStage:3,depAmt:'$750',
     enFollow:'Hi [SAMPLE NAME] — for nightlife/public events our trademark concert stage with state-of-the-art lighting and audio can tour nationally or rig right here in the NYC backyard. Next step: confirm talent + venue needs, then your sample contract draft follows.',
     esFollow:'Hola [NOMBRE DE EJEMPLO]: para vida nocturna/eventos públicos, nuestro escenario de conciertos característico, con iluminación y audio de última generación, puede girar por el país o montarse aquí mismo en NYC. Siguiente paso: confirmar talento + necesidades del lugar, y luego sigue tu borrador de contrato de ejemplo.',
     enContract:'Services: Nightlife & Public Events production — concert stage, lighting, audio, coordination. Deposit: SAMPLE $750, shown as Paid in this sample pipeline. Balance quoted per event.',
     esContract:'Servicios: producción Nightlife & Public Events: escenario de conciertos, iluminación, audio, coordinación. Depósito: SAMPLE $750, mostrado como Pagado en este pipeline de ejemplo. Saldo cotizado por evento.'},
    {id:'brand',icon:'⭐',
     en:'Brand Activation',es:'Activación de marca',
     svcEn:'Brand Activations · Creative & Design · Print & Graphics',svcEs:'Brand Activations · Creative & Design · Print & Graphics',
     depStage:2,depAmt:'$1,000',
     enFollow:'Hi [SAMPLE NAME] — activations are how brands come to life: we turn your mission, values and goals into a memorable, sophisticated experience (think personalization-party style launches). Next step: a creative pass with Creative & Design + Print & Graphics, then your sample contract draft follows.',
     esFollow:'Hola [NOMBRE DE EJEMPLO]: las activaciones dan vida a tu marca: convertimos tu misión, valores y metas en una experiencia memorable y sofisticada (piensa en lanzamientos estilo fiesta de personalización). Siguiente paso: una pasada creativa con Creative & Design + Print & Graphics, y luego sigue tu borrador de contrato de ejemplo.',
     enContract:'Services: Brand Activations with Creative & Design and Print & Graphics (decals, banners, step & repeat, overlays). Deposit: SAMPLE $1,000 to hold the build dates (SAMPLE $500 shown as received). Balance quoted per event.',
     esContract:'Servicios: Brand Activations con Creative & Design y Print & Graphics (calcomanías, banners, step & repeat, overlays). Depósito: SAMPLE $1,000 para apartar las fechas de montaje (SAMPLE $500 mostrado como recibido). Saldo cotizado por evento.'}
  ];
  var selPipe=null, selStep=null;
  var openPipes={};
  function depStageNames(){ return es()?['Solicitado','Parcial','Pagado']:['Requested','Partial','Paid']; }
  function renderPipes(){
    var names=stepNames(), stages=depStageNames();
    pipeBox.innerHTML='<div class="pipe-grid">'+PIPES.map(function(p){
      var steps=names.map(function(n,i){
        var cls='pipe-step'+(selPipe===p.id&&selStep===i?' on':(i<p.depStage+1&&STEPKEYS[i]!=='deposit'?' done':''));
        return '<button type="button" class="'+cls+'" data-pipe="'+p.id+'" data-step="'+i+'">'+n+'</button>';
      }).join('');
      var dep=stages.map(function(s,i){
        var cls='dep-stage'+(i+1<p.depStage?' done':(i+1===p.depStage?' cur':' done'));
        if(i+1<p.depStage)cls='dep-stage done'; else if(i+1===p.depStage)cls='dep-stage cur'; else cls='dep-stage';
        return '<span class="'+cls+'">'+s+'</span>';
      }).join('');
      var isOpen=!!openPipes[p.id];
      return '<div class="pipe-card'+(isOpen?' open':'')+'"><button type="button" class="pipe-head" data-pipe-toggle="'+p.id+'" aria-expanded="'+(isOpen?'true':'false')+'"><span class="pt">'+p.icon+' '+(es()?p.es:p.en)+' '+SAMP+'</span><span class="pipe-chev" aria-hidden="true">▾</span></button>'
        +'<div class="pipe-sum"><span class="psvc">'+(es()?p.svcEs:p.svcEn)+'</span><span class="pdep">'+A('Deposit (SAMPLE): ','Depósito (SAMPLE): ')+p.depAmt+' · '+stages[p.depStage-1]+' · '+A('Tap to open steps','Toca para abrir los pasos')+'</span></div>'
        +'<div class="pipe-body">'
        +'<div class="pipe-steps">'+steps+'</div>'
        +'<div class="dep-stages" aria-label="'+A('Deposit stage (sample)','Etapa del depósito (ejemplo)')+'">'+dep+'</div></div></div>';
    }).join('')+'</div>';
    pipeBox.querySelectorAll('[data-pipe-toggle]').forEach(function(h){
      h.addEventListener('click',function(){
        var id=h.getAttribute('data-pipe-toggle');
        openPipes[id]=!openPipes[id];
        renderPipes();
      });
    });
    pipeBox.querySelectorAll('[data-pipe]').forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){
        selPipe=b.getAttribute('data-pipe'); selStep=parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-step'),10)||0;
        renderPipes(); renderHubDetail();
        hubDetail.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'});
      });
    });
  }
  function renderHubDetail(){
    if(selPipe===null||selStep===null){ hubDetail.className='hub-detail'; hubDetail.innerHTML=''; return; }
    var p=null; for(var i=0;i<PIPES.length;i++)if(PIPES[i].id===selPipe)p=PIPES[i];
    if(!p)return;
    var key=STEPKEYS[selStep], names=stepNames(), stages=depStageNames(), h='';
    var title=(es()?p.es:p.en)+' — '+names[selStep];
    if(key==='inquiry'){
      h='<h4>'+title+' '+SAMP+'</h4><p>'+A('A sample inquiry for this event type has been received (example only — like the sample inquiries under New Inquiries). The pipeline starts automatically: follow-up template ready, contract draft and deposit stage queued behind it. Nothing is sent.',
        'Se recibió una consulta de ejemplo para este tipo de evento (solo ejemplo, como las consultas de ejemplo en Consultas nuevas). El pipeline arranca solo: plantilla de seguimiento lista, borrador de contrato y etapa de depósito en fila detrás. Nada se envía.')+'</p>';
    }else if(key==='followup'){
      h='<h4>'+title+' '+SAMP+'</h4><p>'+A('Customized follow-up for this event type — sample template text:','Seguimiento personalizado para este tipo de evento: texto de plantilla de ejemplo:')+'</p><div class="tpl">'+(es()?p.esFollow:p.enFollow)+'</div><p class="notsent">'+A('Preview only — not sent','Solo vista previa: no enviado')+'</p>';
    }else if(key==='contract'){
      h='<h4>'+title+' '+SAMP+'</h4><div class="tpl"><b>'+A('SAMPLE CONTRACT — PREVIEW ONLY','CONTRATO DE EJEMPLO: SOLO VISTA PREVIA')+'</b>\n'
        +A('Parties: Premiere Vibes Event Production and Design × [SAMPLE CLIENT]. ','Partes: Premiere Vibes Event Production and Design × [CLIENTE DE EJEMPLO]. ')
        +(es()?p.esContract:p.enContract)+'\n'
        +A('Terms note: dates are held only when a real booking is confirmed by email (info@premierevibes.com) and phone (347-709-6712). This preview is not a real contract.','Nota: las fechas solo se apartan cuando una reserva real se confirma por correo (info@premierevibes.com) y teléfono (347-709-6712). Esta vista previa no es un contrato real.')
        +'</div><p class="notsent">'+A('Preview only — not signed, not sent','Solo vista previa: no firmado, no enviado')+'</p>';
    }else if(key==='deposit'){
      h='<h4>'+title+' '+SAMP+'</h4><p>'+A('Deposit tracking stages: Requested → Partial → Paid. This sample pipeline is at stage “'+stages[p.depStage-1]+'” on a SAMPLE amount of '+p.depAmt+'. There is no payment link and no real payment here — tracking display only.',
        'Etapas del depósito: Solicitado → Parcial → Pagado. Este pipeline de ejemplo está en la etapa «'+stages[p.depStage-1]+'» con un monto SAMPLE de '+p.depAmt+'. No hay enlace de pago ni pago real aquí: solo visualización de seguimiento.')+'</p><p class="notsent">'+A('Sample amounts only — no charge','Montos de ejemplo solamente: sin cargo')+'</p>';
    }else{
      h='<h4>'+title+' '+SAMP+'</h4><p>'+A('Final sample stage: once the sample deposit shows Paid, the sample event flips to Confirmed and lands on the sample Calendar as a hold. In this prototype nothing is actually booked — real bookings are confirmed by email and phone.',
        'Etapa final de ejemplo: cuando el depósito de ejemplo muestra Pagado, el evento de ejemplo pasa a Confirmado y cae en el Calendario de ejemplo como reserva. En este prototipo nada se reserva de verdad: las reservas reales se confirman por correo y teléfono.')+'</p>';
    }
    hubDetail.innerHTML=h; hubDetail.className='hub-detail open';
  }

  /* ---------- Activity log + voice / typed hub input ------------------ */
  var logItems=[];
  function log(tag,text){
    logItems.unshift({tag:tag,text:text});
    if(logItems.length>5)logItems.pop();
    /* the standalone voice card that displayed this log was removed —
       voice now lives in the Dashboard Assistant; log() stays as a
       guarded no-op sink so pipeline/conflict actions never break */
    if(logBox)logBox.innerHTML=logItems.map(function(x){ return '<div class="hl"><small>'+x.tag+'</small>'+x.text+'</div>'; }).join('');
  }
  /* ---------- Voice: browser speech recognition + typed fallback ------ */
  var SR=window.SpeechRecognition||window.webkitSpeechRecognition||null;
  function wireMic(btn,inputEl,statusEl,onFinalText){
    if(!btn)return;
    if(!SR){
      btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
        if(statusEl)statusEl.textContent=A('Voice isn\u2019t supported in this browser — type instead, it works the same.','La voz no es compatible en este navegador: escribe en su lugar, funciona igual.');
        /* no programmatic focus here either — the keyboard appears only
           when the user taps inside the input field itself. */
      });
      return;
    }
    var rec=null,listening=false;
    btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
      if(listening){ try{rec.stop();}catch(e){} return; }
      try{
        rec=new SR(); rec.lang=es()?'es-ES':'en-US'; rec.interimResults=true; rec.continuous=false;
        listening=true; btn.classList.add('listening'); btn.setAttribute('aria-label',A('Listening — tap to stop','Escuchando: toca para parar'));
        if(statusEl)statusEl.textContent=A('🎙️ Listening… speak now.','🎙️ Escuchando… habla ahora.');
        rec.onresult=function(ev){
          var txt='';
          for(var i=0;i<ev.results.length;i++)txt+=ev.results[i][0].transcript;
          if(inputEl)inputEl.value=txt;
          if(ev.results[ev.results.length-1].isFinal&&onFinalText)onFinalText(txt);
        };
        rec.onend=function(){ listening=false; btn.classList.remove('listening'); btn.setAttribute('aria-label',A('Start voice input','Iniciar entrada de voz')); if(statusEl&&statusEl.textContent.indexOf('Listening')>-1||statusEl&&statusEl.textContent.indexOf('Escuchando')>-1)statusEl.textContent=''; };
        rec.onerror=function(){ listening=false; btn.classList.remove('listening'); if(statusEl)statusEl.textContent=A('Mic didn\u2019t catch that — try again or type it.','El micrófono no captó eso: inténtalo de nuevo o escríbelo.'); };
        rec.start();
      }catch(e){
        listening=false; btn.classList.remove('listening');
        if(statusEl)statusEl.textContent=A('Voice isn\u2019t available here — type instead.','La voz no está disponible aquí: escribe en su lugar.');
      }
    });
  }
  wireMic(daMic,daInput,null,function(txt){
    /* voice question for the Dashboard Assistant: fill + send through its
       own typed path, so answers stay grounded in the dashboard's data */
    if(!txt||!txt.trim())return;
    daInput.value=txt;
    if(daSend)daSend.click();
  });
  if(daMic&&!SR)daMic.setAttribute('aria-label',A('Voice input not supported here — type your question instead','Entrada de voz no compatible aquí: escribe tu pregunta'));

  /* ---------- Chrome / language --------------------------------------- */
  function chrome(){
    if(pipeLbl)pipeLbl.textContent=A('Operational hub — Pipelines','Centro operativo — Pipelines');
    if(proto)proto.textContent=A('Prototype — Sample data only, not live · Nothing is sent, signed or charged','Prototipo — Solo datos de ejemplo, no en vivo · Nada se envía, firma ni cobra');
    renderConflicts(); renderPipes(); renderHubDetail();
  }
  chrome();
  /* every dashboard open starts with all pipelines collapsed again */
  document.addEventListener('pv-dash-reset',function(){ openPipes={}; selPipe=null; selStep=null; renderPipes(); renderHubDetail(); });
  if(typeof setLang==='function'){
    var _prevHub=setLang;
    setLang=function(l){ _prevHub(l); chrome(); };
  }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ================= OPS UPGRADES PROTOTYPE — five demo panels ============
   PROTOTYPE ONLY. No real service is connected: no Stripe, Wave, Twilio,
   WhatsApp, Gmail, SendGrid, Drive, Dropbox, Zapier or Make. No invoice,
   payment, message, email, review request or file is created in the real
   world. Everything below is SAMPLE data rendered inside this page only,
   preview-only, NOT SENT / NOT CHARGED / NOT UPLOADED. */
(function(){
  var opsContainers={fin:document.getElementById('opsFin'),equip:document.getElementById('opsEquip'),comm:document.getElementById('opsComm'),post:document.getElementById('opsPost'),alerts:document.getElementById('opsAlerts')};
  var root=opsContainers.fin;
  var secLbl=document.getElementById('opsSecLbl');
  var protoB=document.getElementById('opsProtoBanner');
  if(!root)return;
  function es(){ return (typeof LANG!=='undefined'&&LANG==='es'); }
  function A(en,esT){ return es()?esT:en; }
  var SAMP='<span class="sample">Sample</span>';
  function money(n){ return '$'+n.toLocaleString(es()?'es-US':'en-US'); }

  var openOps={fin:false,equip:false,comm:false,post:false,alerts:false};
  var selInv=null, selComm='wa-inq', selPost='google';

  /* ---- (1) FINANCIAL — sample invoices + deposits + reminders ------- */
  var INVOICES=[
    {id:'INV-SAMPLE-001', amt:4200, paid:1000,
     enT:'Sample Corporate Gala — Corporate, Industry & Retail + Audio/Visual Solutions', esT:'Gala corporativa de ejemplo — Corporate, Industry & Retail + Audio/Visual Solutions',
     enDue:'Deposit stage: Partial · Balance SAMPLE $3,200 · Reminder preview ready', esDue:'Depósito: Parcial · Saldo SAMPLE $3,200 · Recordatorio listo para vista previa'},
    {id:'INV-SAMPLE-002', amt:2800, paid:500,
     enT:'Sample Sweet 16 — Social & Celebration + Photo & Cinema + 360 Photobooth', esT:'Sweet 16 de ejemplo — Social & Celebration + Photo & Cinema + Photobooth 360',
     enDue:'Deposit stage: Partial · Balance SAMPLE $2,300 · Reminder preview ready', esDue:'Depósito: Parcial · Saldo SAMPLE $2,300 · Recordatorio listo para vista previa'},
    {id:'INV-SAMPLE-003', amt:3600, paid:3600,
     enT:'Sample Nightlife Event — Nightlife & Public Events + Concert Stage', esT:'Evento nightlife de ejemplo — Nightlife & Public Events + Escenario de conciertos',
     enDue:'Deposit stage: Paid in full (SAMPLE) · No reminder needed', esDue:'Depósito: Pagado completo (SAMPLE) · Sin recordatorio'}
  ];
  function invStatus(inv){
    if(inv.paid>=inv.amt) return {cls:'tag-paid', en:'Paid', es:'Pagado'};
    if(inv.id==='INV-SAMPLE-001') return {cls:'tag-over', en:'Sample overdue', es:'Vencido (ejemplo)'};
    return {cls:'tag-due', en:'Partial', es:'Parcial'};
  }
  function finDetailHTML(){
    if(!selInv) return '';
    var inv=null; for(var i=0;i<INVOICES.length;i++) if(INVOICES[i].id===selInv) inv=INVOICES[i];
    if(!inv) return '';
    var bal=inv.amt-inv.paid;
    var txt=A('SAMPLE INVOICE — PREVIEW ONLY\n','FACTURA DE EJEMPLO — SOLO VISTA PREVIA\n')
      +inv.id+' · '+(es()?inv.esT:inv.enT)+'\n'
      +A('Total (SAMPLE): ','Total (SAMPLE): ')+money(inv.amt)+' · '+A('Paid (SAMPLE): ','Pagado (SAMPLE): ')+money(inv.paid)+' · '+A('Balance (SAMPLE): ','Saldo (SAMPLE): ')+money(bal)+'\n\n'
      +A('SAMPLE PAYMENT REMINDER — PREVIEW ONLY\nHi [SAMPLE NAME] — friendly reminder that a SAMPLE balance of '+money(bal)+' is shown on '+inv.id+'. In this prototype no reminder is sent and no payment link exists. Real bookings are confirmed by email (info@premierevibes.com) and phone (347-709-6712).',
          'RECORDATORIO DE PAGO DE EJEMPLO — SOLO VISTA PREVIA\nHola [NOMBRE DE EJEMPLO]: recordatorio amistoso de que se muestra un saldo SAMPLE de '+money(bal)+' en '+inv.id+'. En este prototipo no se envía ningún recordatorio ni existe enlace de pago. Las reservas reales se confirman por correo (info@premierevibes.com) y teléfono (347-709-6712).');
    return '<div class="ops-detail open" id="finDetail">'+txt+'<div class="notsent">'+A('Preview only — Not sent · No charge · No payment link','Solo vista previa — No enviado · Sin cargo · Sin enlace de pago')+'</div></div>';
  }

  /* ---- (2) EQUIPMENT — sample inventory + auto-check ---------------- */
  var EQUIP=[
    {en:'Sound — Line-array speaker system ×2', es:'Sonido — Sistema de altavoces line-array ×2', st:'ok', enN:'Available for sample bookings', esN:'Disponible para reservas de ejemplo'},
    {en:'Lights — Moving-head wash ×8', es:'Luces — Wash de cabezal móvil ×8', st:'ok', enN:'Available · checked against sample calendar', esN:'Disponible · revisado contra el calendario de ejemplo'},
    {en:'DJ Gear — Mixer + CDJ set', es:'Equipo DJ — Mezclador + set CDJ', st:'crit', enN:'DOUBLE-BOOKED (SAMPLE): wanted by Sample Corporate Gala + Sample Nightlife Event on the same sample date', esN:'DOBLE RESERVA (SAMPLE): lo piden la Gala corporativa de ejemplo + el Evento nightlife de ejemplo en la misma fecha de ejemplo'},
    {en:'Specialty — Custom LED wall ×1', es:'Especial — Muro LED personalizado ×1', st:'crit', enN:'DOUBLE-BOOKED (SAMPLE): one wall, two sample events — see the Urgent alerts at the top', esN:'DOBLE RESERVA (SAMPLE): un muro, dos eventos de ejemplo — ver las Alertas urgentes arriba'},
    {en:'DJ Gear — Wireless mic kit', es:'Equipo DJ — Kit de micrófono inalámbrico', st:'warn', enN:'MISSING GEAR (SAMPLE): 1 receiver flagged missing in sample check — suggested fix: hold a backup kit', esN:'EQUIPO FALTANTE (SAMPLE): 1 receptor marcado faltante en la revisión de ejemplo — solución: apartar un kit de respaldo'},
    {en:'Lights — Uplighting set ×12', es:'Luces — Set de uplighting ×12', st:'ok', enN:'Available', esN:'Disponible'}
  ];

  /* ---- (3) COMMUNICATION HUB — sample templates, NOT SENT ----------- */
  var COMM=[
    {id:'wa-inq', ch:'WhatsApp', enK:'Client inquiry reply', esK:'Respuesta a consulta',
     en:'Hi [SAMPLE NAME] — thanks for reaching out to Premiere Vibes on WhatsApp (SAMPLE). We got your event inquiry. Tell us your date, city and the vibe you want — Imagine, Create, Experience — and we will reply with next steps. Preview only.',
     es:'Hola [NOMBRE DE EJEMPLO]: gracias por escribir a Premiere Vibes por WhatsApp (SAMPLE). Recibimos tu consulta. Cuéntanos fecha, ciudad y la vibra que quieres — Imagina, Crea, Vive la experiencia — y te respondemos con los siguientes pasos. Solo vista previa.'},
    {id:'sms-staff', ch:'Text Message', enK:'Staff timeline', esK:'Horario para el equipo',
     en:'SAMPLE STAFF TIMELINE — TEXT MESSAGE PREVIEW: Load-in 2:00 PM · Soundcheck 4:30 PM · Doors 7:00 PM · Show 8:00 PM. LVL Studios sample hold. Bring Audio/Visual kit A. Preview only — no text is sent.',
     es:'HORARIO DE EJEMPLO PARA EL EQUIPO — VISTA PREVIA DE MENSAJE DE TEXTO: Montaje 2:00 PM · Prueba de sonido 4:30 PM · Puertas 7:00 PM · Show 8:00 PM. Reserva de ejemplo en LVL Studios. Traer kit A de Audio/Visual. Solo vista previa: no se envía ningún texto.'},
    {id:'email-rem', ch:'Email', enK:'Pre-event reminder', esK:'Recordatorio pre-evento',
     en:'Subject: Your Premiere Vibes event is coming up (SAMPLE)\nHi [SAMPLE NAME] — your sample event is almost here. Timeline, parking and day-of contact are confirmed by phone (347-709-6712) for real bookings. This email is a preview only — NOT SENT.',
     es:'Asunto: Tu evento con Premiere Vibes se acerca (SAMPLE)\nHola [NOMBRE DE EJEMPLO]: tu evento de ejemplo ya casi llega. Para reservas reales, el horario, estacionamiento y contacto del día se confirman por teléfono (347-709-6712). Este correo es solo vista previa: NO ENVIADO.'},
    {id:'wa-rem', ch:'WhatsApp', enK:'Pre-event reminder', esK:'Recordatorio pre-evento',
     en:'Hi [SAMPLE NAME] — quick Premiere Vibes reminder (SAMPLE): we are set for your sample event. Reply here in a real booking to confirm guest count. Preview only — NOT SENT via WhatsApp.',
     es:'Hola [NOMBRE DE EJEMPLO]: recordatorio rápido de Premiere Vibes (SAMPLE): estamos listos para tu evento de ejemplo. En una reserva real, responde aquí para confirmar invitados. Solo vista previa: NO ENVIADO por WhatsApp.'}
  ];

  /* ---- (4) POST-EVENT — review previews, feedback, media list ------- */
  var POST_TPL={
    google:{enK:'Google review request', esK:'Solicitud de reseña de Google',
      en:'Hi [SAMPLE NAME] — thank you for celebrating with Premiere Vibes (SAMPLE). If we earned it, a Google review helps other clients find us. [SAMPLE LINK — NOT A REAL LINK] Preview only — NOT SENT.',
      es:'Hola [NOMBRE DE EJEMPLO]: gracias por celebrar con Premiere Vibes (SAMPLE). Si nos lo ganamos, una reseña en Google ayuda a que otros clientes nos encuentren. [ENLACE DE EJEMPLO — NO ES UN ENLACE REAL] Solo vista previa: NO ENVIADO.'},
    yelp:{enK:'Yelp review request', esK:'Solicitud de reseña de Yelp',
      en:'Hi [SAMPLE NAME] — we loved producing your sample event. A short Yelp review means the world to our Jersey City team. [SAMPLE LINK — NOT A REAL LINK] Preview only — NOT SENT.',
      es:'Hola [NOMBRE DE EJEMPLO]: nos encantó producir tu evento de ejemplo. Una reseña corta en Yelp significa mucho para nuestro equipo de Jersey City. [ENLACE DE EJEMPLO — NO ES UN ENLACE REAL] Solo vista previa: NO ENVIADO.'}
  };
  var MEDIA=[
    {en:'sample-gala-recap.mp4 — Photo & Cinema recap (SAMPLE)', es:'sample-gala-recap.mp4 — Recap de Foto y Cine (SAMPLE)'},
    {en:'sample-sweet16-photos/ — 24 sample photos listed (SAMPLE)', es:'sample-sweet16-photos/ — 24 fotos de ejemplo listadas (SAMPLE)'},
    {en:'sample-brand-activation-stills/ — 12 sample stills listed (SAMPLE)', es:'sample-brand-activation-stills/ — 12 imágenes de ejemplo listadas (SAMPLE)'}
  ];

  /* ---- (5) ADMIN ALERTS — sample self-healing feed ------------------ */
  var ALERTS=[
    {lvl:'crit', enT:'SAMPLE — Broken webhook (demo)', esT:'SAMPLE — Webhook roto (demo)',
     enD:'Sample dashboard → sample CRM webhook returned 404 in this demo log. Self-healing: auto-retry logged ×3, then paused so nothing loops forever.', esD:'El webhook de ejemplo panel → CRM de ejemplo devolvió 404 en este registro demo. Auto-reparación: reintento automático ×3, luego pausa para que nada entre en bucle.',
     enF:'Suggested manual fix: in a real setup, re-copy the webhook URL from the receiving app, re-enable the connection, then run one test event and confirm a 200 response here.', esF:'Solución manual sugerida: en una configuración real, vuelve a copiar la URL del webhook desde la app receptora, reactiva la conexión, ejecuta un evento de prueba y confirma una respuesta 200 aquí.'},
    {lvl:'amber', enT:'SAMPLE — API rate limit hit (demo)', esT:'SAMPLE — Límite de API alcanzado (demo)',
     enD:'Sample messaging API returned 429 in this demo log during a sample reminder batch. Self-healing: batch paused and queued in this demo view only.', esD:'La API de mensajería de ejemplo devolvió 429 en este registro demo durante un lote de recordatorios de ejemplo. Auto-reparación: lote pausado y en fila solo en esta vista demo.',
     enF:'Suggested manual fix: space reminders out, check the provider quota page, and resume only after the limit window resets. No real message was sent.', esF:'Solución manual sugerida: espacia los recordatorios, revisa la cuota del proveedor y reanuda solo cuando se reinicie la ventana del límite. No se envió ningún mensaje real.'},
    {lvl:'amber', enT:'SAMPLE — Failed action: invoice email (demo)', esT:'SAMPLE — Acción fallida: correo de factura (demo)',
     enD:'Sample invoice INV-SAMPLE-001 email step failed to queue in this demo log (sample recipient bounced in the simulation).', esD:'El paso de correo de la factura de ejemplo INV-SAMPLE-001 no entró en fila en este registro demo (destinatario de ejemplo rebotado en la simulación).',
     enF:'Suggested manual fix: verify the client email on file, correct it, then re-send from the invoice preview. In this prototype nothing is sent.', esF:'Solución manual sugerida: verifica el correo del cliente, corrígelo y reenvía desde la vista previa de la factura. En este prototipo nada se envía.'},
    {lvl:'info', enT:'SAMPLE — Self-healing check passed (demo)', esT:'SAMPLE — Revisión de auto-reparación OK (demo)',
     enD:'Demo health check: sample pipelines, sample conflict monitor and sample deposit tracker all responded in-page. No external endpoint was tested.', esD:'Revisión demo: pipelines de ejemplo, monitor de conflictos de ejemplo y rastreador de depósitos de ejemplo respondieron dentro de la página. No se probó ningún endpoint externo.',
     enF:'Suggested manual fix: none needed. Keep this feed visible before any real integration is approved.', esF:'Solución manual sugerida: ninguna. Mantén este feed visible antes de aprobar cualquier integración real.'}
  ];

  function cardHead(id,icon,title,sub){
    return '<button type="button" class="ops-head" data-ops-toggle="'+id+'" aria-expanded="'+(openOps[id]?'true':'false')+'"><span class="ops-ic" aria-hidden="true">'+icon+'</span><span class="ops-tt"><b>'+title+' '+SAMP+'</b><span>'+sub+'</span></span><span class="ops-chev" aria-hidden="true">'+(openOps[id]?'⌄':'›')+'</span></button>';
  }
  function renderOps(){
    var totInv=0,totPaid=0,i;
    for(i=0;i<INVOICES.length;i++){ totInv+=INVOICES[i].amt; totPaid+=INVOICES[i].paid; }
    var totOut=totInv-totPaid;
    var finH='',equipH='',commH='',postH='',alertsH='';

    /* FINANCE */
    finH='<div class="ops-card'+(openOps.fin?' open':'')+'" data-ops-card="fin">'
      +cardHead('fin','💰',A('Financial Tracking & Invoicing','Finanzas y facturación'),A('Sample invoices · deposits · reminders — preview only','Facturas · depósitos · recordatorios de ejemplo — solo vista previa'))
      +'<div class="ops-summary"><span><b>'+money(totInv)+'</b>'+A('invoiced','facturado')+'</span><span><b>'+money(totPaid)+'</b>'+A('collected','cobrado')+'</span><span><b>'+money(totOut)+'</b>'+A('outstanding','pendiente')+'</span></div>'
      +'<div class="ops-body"><p class="ops-mini">'+A('Sample financial dashboard — updates from sample data on this page only','Panel financiero de ejemplo — se actualiza solo con datos de ejemplo de esta página')+'</p>'
      +'<div class="ops-list">'+INVOICES.map(function(inv){ var st=invStatus(inv); return '<button type="button" class="ops-row" data-inv="'+inv.id+'"><b>'+inv.id+'<span class="ops-tag '+st.cls+'">'+(es()?st.es:st.en)+'</span></b><p>'+(es()?inv.esT:inv.enT)+'</p><p>'+(es()?inv.esDue:inv.enDue)+' · '+money(inv.amt)+'</p></button>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
      +finDetailHTML()
      +'<p class="ops-note">'+A('Tap an invoice to preview it and its payment reminder. No Stripe, Wave or any accounting service is connected — nothing is issued, sent or charged.','Toca una factura para verla y ver su recordatorio de pago. No hay Stripe, Wave ni ningún servicio contable conectado: nada se emite, envía ni cobra.')+'</p></div></div>';

    /* EQUIPMENT */
    var critN=0,warnN=0; for(i=0;i<EQUIP.length;i++){ if(EQUIP[i].st==='crit')critN++; if(EQUIP[i].st==='warn')warnN++; }
    equipH='<div class="ops-card'+(openOps.equip?' open':'')+'" data-ops-card="equip">'
      +cardHead('equip','🔊',A('Schedule & Equipment Logistics','Horarios y logística de equipo'),A('Sample inventory auto-checked against sample bookings','Inventario de ejemplo revisado contra reservas de ejemplo'))
      +'<div class="ops-summary"><span><b>'+critN+'</b>'+A('double-booked','doble reserva')+'</span><span><b>'+warnN+'</b>'+A('missing gear','equipo faltante')+'</span><span><b>'+(EQUIP.length-critN-warnN)+'</b>'+A('available','disponibles')+'</span></div>'
      +'<div class="ops-body"><p class="ops-mini">'+A('Auto-check result (SAMPLE): '+critN+' double-bookings · '+warnN+' missing gear','Resultado automático (SAMPLE): '+critN+' dobles reservas · '+warnN+' equipo faltante')+'</p>'
      +'<div class="ops-list">'+EQUIP.map(function(e){ var tag=e.st==='ok'?'<span class="ops-tag tag-ok">'+A('Available','Disponible')+'</span>':(e.st==='crit'?'<span class="ops-tag tag-crit">'+A('Double-booked','Doble reserva')+'</span>':'<span class="ops-tag tag-warn">'+A('Missing gear','Equipo faltante')+'</span>'); return '<div class="ops-row" style="cursor:default"><b>'+(es()?e.es:e.en)+tag+'</b><p>'+(es()?e.esN:e.enN)+'</p></div>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
      +'<p class="ops-note">'+A('Flags come from the sample bookings already shown in this dashboard (same LED wall and DJ gear as the Urgent alerts at the top). Sample only — no real inventory or booking changes.','Las marcas salen de las reservas de ejemplo ya mostradas en este panel (el mismo muro LED y equipo DJ de las Alertas urgentes de arriba). Solo ejemplo: sin cambios reales de inventario ni reservas.')+'</p></div></div>';

    /* COMMUNICATION HUB */
    var curComm=null; for(i=0;i<COMM.length;i++) if(COMM[i].id===selComm) curComm=COMM[i];
    commH='<div class="ops-card'+(openOps.comm?' open':'')+'" data-ops-card="comm">'
      +cardHead('comm','💬',A('Multi-Channel Communication Hub','Centro de comunicación multicanal'),A('WhatsApp · Text Message · Email templates — preview only, NOT SENT','Plantillas WhatsApp · Mensaje de texto · Email — solo vista previa, NO ENVIADO'))
      +'<div class="ops-summary"><span><b>4</b>'+A('templates','plantillas')+'</span><span>WhatsApp · Text Message · Email</span><span>'+A('Preview only — not sent','Solo vista previa — no enviado')+'</span></div>'
      +'<div class="ops-body"><p class="ops-mini">'+A('Sample templates — tap to preview','Plantillas de ejemplo — toca para ver')+'</p>'
      +'<div class="ops-chips">'+COMM.map(function(c){ return '<button type="button" class="ops-chip'+(selComm===c.id?' on':'')+'" data-comm="'+c.id+'">'+c.ch+' · '+(es()?c.esK:c.enK)+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
      +(curComm?'<div class="ops-detail open">'+(es()?curComm.es:curComm.en)+'<div class="notsent">'+A('Preview only — Not sent · No webhook connected to '+curComm.ch,'Solo vista previa — No enviado · Sin webhook conectado a '+curComm.ch)+'</div></div>':'')
      +'<p class="ops-note">'+A('Covers client inquiries, staff timelines and pre-event reminders. No WhatsApp Business, Twilio, Gmail or SendGrid connection exists in this prototype — no message is sent on any channel.','Cubre consultas de clientes, horarios del equipo y recordatorios pre-evento. En este prototipo no existe conexión con WhatsApp Business, Twilio, Gmail ni SendGrid: no se envía ningún mensaje por ningún canal.')+'</p></div></div>';

    /* POST-EVENT */
    var curPost=POST_TPL[selPost]||POST_TPL.google;
    postH='<div class="ops-card'+(openOps.post?' open':'')+'" data-ops-card="post">'
      +cardHead('post','⭐',A('Post-Event Automation Pipeline','Pipeline post-evento'),A('Review requests · feedback · media archive — all sample previews','Reseñas · feedback · archivo de medios — todo vista previa de ejemplo'))
      +'<div class="ops-summary"><span>Google · Yelp</span><span><b>3</b>'+A('media files listed','archivos listados')+'</span><span>'+A('Feedback form inside','Formulario de feedback dentro')+'</span></div>'
      +'<div class="ops-body"><p class="ops-mini">'+A('Sample review requests — tap to preview','Solicitudes de reseña de ejemplo — toca para ver')+'</p>'
      +'<div class="ops-chips"><button type="button" class="ops-chip'+(selPost==='google'?' on':'')+'" data-post="google">Google</button><button type="button" class="ops-chip'+(selPost==='yelp'?' on':'')+'" data-post="yelp">Yelp</button></div>'
      +'<div class="ops-detail open"><b>'+(es()?curPost.esK:curPost.enK)+' '+SAMP+'</b>\n'+(es()?curPost.es:curPost.en)+'<div class="notsent">'+A('Preview only — Not sent','Solo vista previa — No enviado')+'</div></div>'
      +'<p class="ops-mini" style="margin-top:14px">'+A('Sample feedback form — preview only','Formulario de feedback de ejemplo — solo vista previa')+'</p>'
      +'<form class="ops-form" id="opsFeedbackForm"><label>'+A('How was your sample event? (1–5)','¿Cómo fue tu evento de ejemplo? (1–5)')+'<select id="opsFbRating"><option>5</option><option>4</option><option>3</option><option>2</option><option>1</option></select></label><label>'+A('Sample comment','Comentario de ejemplo')+'<textarea id="opsFbText" rows="2" placeholder="'+A('Sample feedback…','Feedback de ejemplo…')+'"></textarea></label><button type="submit">'+A('Preview submit (nothing is collected)','Enviar vista previa (no se recopila nada)')+'</button><div class="voice-status" id="opsFbStatus" aria-live="polite"></div></form>'
      +'<p class="ops-mini" style="margin-top:14px">'+A('Sample media archive — listed only, NOT uploaded','Archivo de medios de ejemplo — solo listado, NO subido')+'</p>'
      +'<div class="ops-list">'+MEDIA.map(function(m){ return '<div class="ops-row" style="cursor:default"><b>'+(es()?m.es:m.en)+'</b><p>'+A('Status (SAMPLE): listed for archive in this demo · NOT uploaded to Google Drive, Dropbox or anywhere','Estado (SAMPLE): listado para archivo en esta demo · NO subido a Google Drive, Dropbox ni a ningún lado')+'</p></div>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
      +'</div></div>';

    /* ADMIN ALERTS */
    alertsH='<div class="ops-card'+(openOps.alerts?' open':'')+'" data-ops-card="alerts">'
      +cardHead('alerts','🛡️',A('Administrator Alerts — Self-Healing & Errors','Alertas de administrador — Auto-reparación y errores'),A('Sample broken-webhook, rate-limit & failed-action feed','Feed de ejemplo: webhooks, límites y acciones fallidas'))
      +'<div class="ops-summary"><span><b>'+ALERTS.length+'</b>'+A('alerts','alertas')+'</span><span><b>1</b>'+A('critical','crítica')+'</span><span>'+A('Each has a suggested fix','Cada una tiene solución sugerida')+'</span></div>'
      +'<div class="ops-body"><p class="ops-mini">'+A('Administrator Alerts feed (SAMPLE) — newest first · each with a suggested manual fix','Feed de Alertas de administrador (SAMPLE) — más reciente primero · cada una con solución manual sugerida')+'</p>'
      +'<div class="ops-list">'+ALERTS.map(function(a){ var cls=a.lvl==='crit'?'crit':(a.lvl==='amber'?'amber':'info'); var flag=a.lvl==='crit'?A('Critical','Crítico'):(a.lvl==='amber'?A('Warning','Aviso'):A('Info · OK','Info · OK')); return '<div class="alert-row '+cls+'"><b>'+(es()?a.esT:a.enT)+' · '+flag+'</b><p>'+(es()?a.esD:a.enD)+'</p><p class="fix"><b>'+A('Fix: ','Solución: ')+'</b>'+(es()?a.esF:a.enF)+'</p></div>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
      +'<button type="button" class="ops-chip" id="opsRecheckAlerts" style="margin-top:10px">'+A('Re-run sample health check','Repetir revisión de salud de ejemplo')+'</button><div class="voice-status" id="opsAlertStatus" aria-live="polite"></div>'
      +'<p class="ops-note">'+A('Self-healing in this prototype is simulated in-page only: retries are logged, loops are paused, and the fix is suggested for a human. No real webhook, API or endpoint was tested or connected.','La auto-reparación en este prototipo es simulada solo dentro de la página: los reintentos se registran, los bucles se pausan y la solución se sugiere para una persona. No se probó ni conectó ningún webhook, API ni endpoint real.')+'</p></div></div>';

    if(opsContainers.fin)opsContainers.fin.innerHTML=finH;
    if(opsContainers.equip)opsContainers.equip.innerHTML=equipH;
    if(opsContainers.comm)opsContainers.comm.innerHTML=commH;
    if(opsContainers.post)opsContainers.post.innerHTML=postH;
    if(opsContainers.alerts)opsContainers.alerts.innerHTML=alertsH;
    var fs=document.getElementById('finSum'); if(fs)fs.textContent=money(totOut)+' '+A('outstanding','pendiente');
    wireOps();
  }
  function wireOps(){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-ops-toggle]').forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){
        var id=b.getAttribute('data-ops-toggle'); openOps[id]=!openOps[id]; renderOps();
        var card=document.querySelector('[data-ops-card="'+id+'"]'); if(card&&openOps[id]) card.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'});
      });
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#dash [data-inv]').forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){ selInv=b.getAttribute('data-inv'); if(!openOps.fin)openOps.fin=true; renderOps(); var d=document.getElementById('finDetail'); if(d)d.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'}); });
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#dash [data-comm]').forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){ selComm=b.getAttribute('data-comm'); renderOps(); });
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#dash [data-post]').forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){ selPost=b.getAttribute('data-post'); renderOps(); });
    });
    var fb=document.getElementById('opsFeedbackForm');
    if(fb)fb.addEventListener('submit',function(e){ e.preventDefault(); var st=document.getElementById('opsFbStatus'); if(st)st.textContent=A('Preview only — feedback NOT collected, NOT sent anywhere. (SAMPLE)','Solo vista previa — el feedback NO se recopila ni se envía a ningún lado. (SAMPLE)'); });
    var rc=document.getElementById('opsRecheckAlerts');
    if(rc)rc.addEventListener('click',function(){ var st=document.getElementById('opsAlertStatus'); if(st)st.textContent=A('Sample health check re-run: '+ALERTS.length+' sample alerts in the feed above — no external endpoint was tested.','Revisión de ejemplo repetida: '+ALERTS.length+' alertas de ejemplo en el feed de arriba — no se probó ningún endpoint externo.'); });
  }
  function chromeOps(){
    if(secLbl)secLbl.textContent=A('Operations upgrades — Prototype demo','Mejoras operativas — Demo prototipo');
    if(protoB)protoB.textContent=A('Prototype — Sample data only, not live · No service is connected · Nothing is sent, charged or uploaded','Prototipo — Solo datos de ejemplo, no en vivo · Ningún servicio está conectado · Nada se envía, cobra ni sube');
    renderOps();
  }
  chromeOps();
  /* every dashboard open starts with all five ops panels collapsed again */
  document.addEventListener('pv-dash-reset',function(){ openOps={fin:false,equip:false,comm:false,post:false,alerts:false}; selInv=null; renderOps(); });
  if(typeof setLang==='function'){
    var _prevOps=setLang;
    setLang=function(l){ _prevOps(l); chromeOps(); };
  }
})();
</script>

7],[0,667,1000,667],[1000,667,1000,667],[2000,667,1000,667],[3000,667,1000,667],[4000,667,1000,667],[5000,667,1000,667],[0,1334,1000,667],[1000,1334,1000,667],[2000,1334,1000,667],[3000,1334,1000,667],[4000,1334,1000,667],[5000,1334,1000,667],[0,2001,1000,667],[1000,2001,1000,667],[2000,2001,1000,667],[3000,2001,1000,667],[4000,2001,1000,667],[5000,2001,1000,667]]],[6000,[[0,0,1000,667],[1000,0,1000,667],[2000,0,1000,667],[3000,0,1000,667],[4000,0,1000,667],[5000,0,1000,667],[0,667,1000,667],[1000,667,1000,667],[2000,667,1000,667],[3000,667,1000,667],[4000,667,1000,667],[5000,667,1000,667],[0,1334,1000,667]]]],"31":[[6000,[[0,0,1000,667],[1000,0,1000,1500],[2000,0,1000,1250],[3000,0,1000,667],[4000,0,1000,1500],[5000,0,1000,667],[0,1500,1000,667],[1000,1500,1000,1500],[2000,1500,1000,667],[3000,1500,1000,1500],[4000,1500,1000,667],[5000,1500,1000,667],[0,3000,1000,667],[1000,3000,1000,667],[2000,3000,1000,1500],[3000,3000,1000,667],[4000,3000,1000,667],[5000,3000,1000,667],[0,4500,1000,1500],[1000,4500,1000,1500],[2000,4500,1000,667],[3000,4500,1000,1500],[4000,4500,1000,667],[5000,4500,1000,667]]],[6000,[[0,0,1000,1500],[1000,0,1000,667],[2000,0,1000,667],[3000,0,1000,667],[4000,0,1000,1500],[5000,0,1000,667],[0,1500,1000,667],[1000,1500,1000,667],[2000,1500,1000,667],[3000,1500,1000,667],[4000,1500,1000,667],[5000,1500,1000,1500]]]]};
function momSprInfo(ix,k){
  const P=MOMSPR[ix+1];if(!P)return null;
  const c=Math.floor((k-2)/24),chunk=P[c];if(!chunk)return null;
  const r=chunk[1][(k-2)%24];if(!r)return null;
  return {src:'assets/moments/s'+String(ix+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+(c+1)+'.webp',sw:chunk[0],x:r[0],y:r[1],w:r[2],h:r[3]};
}
function momSprPct(v){return Math.round(v*10000)/10000;}
function momSprImgStyle(info){return 'width:'+momSprPct(info.sw/info.w*100)+'%;left:'+momSprPct(-info.x/info.w*100)+'%;top:'+momSprPct(-info.y/info.h*100)+'%';}
function momSprSpan(ix,k,alt){
  const info=momSprInfo(ix,k);
  if(!info)return '<img data-light="'+ix+':'+k+'" src="'+momPad(ix+1,k)+'" alt="'+alt+'" loading="lazy"/>';
  return '<span class="mom-spr" data-light="'+ix+':'+k+'" style="aspect-ratio:'+info.w+'/'+info.h+'"><img src="'+info.src+'" alt="'+alt+'" loading="lazy" style="'+momSprImgStyle(info)+'"/></span>';
}
function momEsc(s){return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;');}
function momDate(m){return LANG==='es'?m.ds:m.d;}
function momHasVid(m){return !!(m.v||m.nv>0);}
/* Big-stage filter for the MORE THAN MUSIC "See the work →" pill
   (Taylor's order): ONLY existing moments whose cover photo CLEARLY
   shows a big stage — 24 Hrs of Peace (giant LED wall + truss + DJ on
   stage), Pizza Zoo (full outdoor stage, lighting rig, performers),
   Ashanti - American Dream (arena-scale stage, dancers, huge crowd).
   Every other moment was checked and left out on purpose: parties,
   weddings, brand activations, food fests, sports and store events
   are not big-stage shows. Indices are MOMENTS positions; cards keep
   their original "NN / 41" counters and open their existing detail. */
const MOM_STAGE=[14,15,28];
function momListHTML(){
  const es=LANG==='es';
  const stageOnly=window.__momStageOnly===true;
  const cardOf=function(m,ix){
    return '<button class="mom-card" type="button" data-mom="'+ix+'" aria-label="'+momEsc(m.t)+'"><span class="mom-cover"><img class="mom-cover-bg" src="'+momPad(ix+1,1)+'" alt="" aria-hidden="true" loading="lazy"/><img class="mom-cover-img" src="'+momPad(ix+1,1)+'" alt="'+momEsc(m.t)+' — Premiere Vibes photo" loading="lazy"/></span><span class="mom-meta"><span class="mom-num">'+String(ix+1).padStart(2,'0')+' / 41</span><span class="mom-title">'+momEsc(m.t)+'</span><span class="mom-sub"><span class="md">'+momEsc(momDate(m))+'</span> · '+m.np+' '+(es?(m.np===1?'foto':'fotos'):(m.np===1?'photo':'photos'))+(momHasVid(m)?' · Video':'')+'</span></span><span class="mom-view"><span>'+(es?'Ver fotos':'View photos')+'</span><span class="mom-varr" aria-hidden="true">→</span></span></button>';
  };
  const idxs=stageOnly?MOM_STAGE:MOMENTS.map(function(_,i){return i;});
  const cards=idxs.map(function(ix){return cardOf(MOMENTS[ix],ix);}).join('');
  const head=stageOnly
    ?'<h3 class="mom-count">'+(es?'Eventos en escenarios grandes':'Big-Stage Events')+' <span>· '+MOM_STAGE.length+'</span></h3><button class="mom-backbtn" type="button" data-momall="1">← '+(es?'Todos los momentos':'All moments')+'</button>'
    :'<h3 class="mom-count">'+(es?'Todos los momentos':'All moments')+'</h3>';
  return '<div class="mom-stage">'+head
    +'<div class="mom-list">'+cards+'</div></div>';
}
function momDetailHTML(ix){
  const m=MOMENTS[ix], es=LANG==='es';
  let h='<h3 class="mom-d-title">'+momEsc(m.t)+'</h3><p class="mom-d-date">'+momEsc(momDate(m))+'</p>';
  if(m.nv>0){
    for(let k=1;k<=m.nv;k++){
      h+='<div class="mom-vid"><video src="assets/moments/v'+String(ix+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+k+'.mp4" poster="'+momPad(ix+1,1)+'" controls playsinline preload="metadata" aria-label="'+momEsc(m.t)+' — video '+(m.nv>1?k+' ':'')+'"></video></div>';
    }
  }
  if(m.v){
    h+='<div class="mom-vid"><div class="mv-frame"><iframe src="'+m.v+'" allow="autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen loading="lazy" title="'+momEsc(m.t)+' — video"></iframe></div></div>';
  }
  if(m.x)h+='<p class="mom-d-desc">'+momEsc(m.x)+'</p>';
  if(m.np>0){
    h+='<figure class="mom-feat"><img data-light="'+ix+':1" src="'+momPad(ix+1,1)+'" alt="'+momEsc(m.t)+' — photo 1 of '+m.np+'" loading="lazy"/></figure>';
    if(m.np>1){
      h+='<div class="mom-gal">';
      for(let k=2;k<=m.np;k++){
        h+='<figure>'+momSprSpan(ix,k,momEsc(m.t)+' — photo '+k+' of '+m.np)+'</figure>';
      }
      h+='</div>';
    }
    h+='<p class="mom-gal-note">'+m.np+' '+(es?(m.np===1?'foto de esta noche':'fotos de esta noche'):(m.np===1?'photo from this night':'photos from this night'))+' · '+(es?'Toca una foto para verla completa':'Tap any photo to see it full')+'</p>';
  }
  h+='<button class="mom-backbtn" type="button" data-momback="1">← '+(es?'Todos los momentos':'All moments')+'</button>';
  return h;
}
function renderMomDetail(ix){
  momDetail=ix;
  vsTitle.textContent=MOMENTS[ix].t;
  vsBody.innerHTML=momDetailHTML(ix);
  viewSheet.scrollTop=0;
}
window.__wireMom=function(){
  if(curView!=='moments')return;
  if(momDetail!==null){renderMomDetail(momDetail);return;}
  momDetail=null;
};
window.__momBack=function(){
  if(curView!=='moments'||momDetail===null)return false;
  momDetail=null;
  vsTitle.textContent=VIEW_TITLES.moments[LANG];
  vsBody.innerHTML=momListHTML();
  viewSheet.scrollTop=0;
  return true;
};
/* delegated taps inside the view sheet: moment cards + slideshow photos open
   that moment; gallery photos open the full-photo lightbox */
vsBody.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  const mall=e.target.closest('[data-momall]');
  if(mall){window.__momStageOnly=false;vsBody.innerHTML=momListHTML();viewSheet.scrollTop=0;return;}
  const bk=e.target.closest('[data-momback]');
  if(bk){if(window.__momBack)window.__momBack();return;}
  const li=e.target.closest('[data-light]');
  if(li){const pr=li.getAttribute('data-light').split(':');openMomLight(+pr[0],+pr[1]);return;}
  const cd=e.target.closest('[data-mom]');
  if(cd){renderMomDetail(+cd.getAttribute('data-mom'));}
});
/* MORE THAN MUSIC "See the work →" pill — opens the Moments gallery
   filtered to big-stage events only (see MOM_STAGE above); every other
   Moments entry (Gallery pill, hub) opens the full unfiltered list */
const stageWorkBtn=document.getElementById('stageWorkBtn');
if(stageWorkBtn)stageWorkBtn.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
  window.__momStageOnly=true;momDetail=null;openView('moments');
});
/* lightbox */
const momLight=document.getElementById('momLight'),momLightImg=document.getElementById('momLightImg');
let momLb={ix:0,k:1};
function momLbShow(){
  const m=MOMENTS[momLb.ix];
  const sprEl=document.getElementById('momLightSpr'),sprImg=document.getElementById('momLightSprImg');
  const info=momLb.k>=2?momSprInfo(momLb.ix,momLb.k):null;
  if(info){
    momLightImg.removeAttribute('src');momLightImg.style.display='none';
    const s=Math.min(window.innerWidth/info.w,(window.innerHeight-110)/info.h);
    sprEl.style.display='block';sprEl.style.width=Math.max(1,Math.floor(info.w*s))+'px';sprEl.style.height=Math.max(1,Math.floor(info.h*s))+'px';
    sprImg.src=info.src;sprImg.alt=m.t+' — photo '+momLb.k+' of '+m.np;sprImg.style.cssText=momSprImgStyle(info);
  }else{
    if(sprEl){sprEl.style.display='none';sprImg.removeAttribute('src');}
    momLightImg.style.display='';
    momLightImg.src=momPad(momLb.ix+1,momLb.k);
    momLightImg.alt=m.t+' — photo '+momLb.k+' of '+m.np;
  }
  document.getElementById('momLbCount').textContent=momLb.k+' / '+m.np;
  document.getElementById('momLbClose').textContent=(LANG==='es'?'✕ Cerrar':'✕ Close');
  const multi=m.np>1;
  document.getElementById('momLbPrev').style.display=multi?'grid':'none';
  document.getElementById('momLbNext').style.display=multi?'grid':'none';
}
function momLbStep(d){const m=MOMENTS[momLb.ix];momLb.k=((momLb.k-1+d)+m.np)%m.np+1;momLbShow();}
function openMomLight(ix,k){momLb={ix:ix,k:k};momLbShow();momLight.classList.add('open');momLight.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');lockScroll();}
function closeMomLight(){if(!momLight.classList.contains('open'))return;momLight.classList.remove('open');momLight.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');momLightImg.removeAttribute('src');const mls=document.getElementById('momLightSpr');if(mls){mls.style.display='none';document.getElementById('momLightSprImg').removeAttribute('src');}unlockScroll();}
window.addEventListener('resize',function(){if(momLight.classList.contains('open'))momLbShow();});
momLight.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===momLight)closeMomLight();});
document.getElementById('momLightX').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();closeMomLight();});
document.getElementById('momLbClose').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();closeMomLight();});
document.getElementById('momLbPrev').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();momLbStep(-1);});
document.getElementById('momLbNext').addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();momLbStep(1);});
let momLbTx=null;
momLight.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){momLbTx=e.touches[0].clientX;},{passive:true});
momLight.addEventListener('touchend',function(e){if(momLbTx===null)return;const dx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-momLbTx;if(Math.abs(dx)>42)momLbStep(dx<0?1:-1);momLbTx=null;},{passive:true});
/* Vibes Moments sheet — the Feel the vibes slideshow as its own view */
const vibesSheet=document.getElementById('vibesSheet');
function vibesI18n(){
  document.getElementById('vibesBack').textContent=(LANG==='es'?'← Atrás':'← Back');
  document.getElementById('vibesTitle').textContent=(LANG==='es'?'Momentos Vibes':'Vibes Moments');
}
function openVibes(){
  if(vibesSheet.classList.contains('open'))return;
  vibesSheet.classList.add('open');vibesSheet.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');vibesSheet.scrollTop=0;lockScroll();
  if(window.__vidPrime)window.__vidPrime();
  try{window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));}catch(e){}
}
function closeVibes(){
  if(!vibesSheet.classList.contains('open'))return;
  vibesSheet.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(function(v){try{v.pause();}catch(e){}});
  vibesSheet.classList.remove('open');vibesSheet.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');unlockScroll();
}
var vibesPillEl=document.getElementById('vibesPill'); if(vibesPillEl)vibesPillEl.addEventListener('click',openVibes);
document.getElementById('vibesBack').addEventListener('click',closeVibes);
vibesI18n();
/* language chain: keep vibes labels + an open Moments view in step */
(function(){
  var _pv=setLang;
  setLang=function(l){ _pv(l); vibesI18n(); if(curView==='moments'&&window.__wireMom)window.__wireMom(); };
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ================= HERO BOOK NOW PILL — dedicated wiring =================
   The hero Book Now pill must never depend on a single shared delegated
   listener: it gets its own direct handler here, in its own script block.
   It opens the in-page Book view through openView('book'); if that path
   did not actually open the view (checked synchronously after the call),
   it force-renders the same Book view into the sheet itself, so the tap
   always lands on the booking page. */
(function(){
  var btn=document.getElementById('heroBookBtn');
  if(!btn)return;
  function bookIsOpen(){
    var vs=document.getElementById('viewSheet');
    if(!vs||!vs.classList.contains('open'))return false;
    var body=document.getElementById('vsBody');
    return !!(body&&(body.querySelector('#bookForm')||body.querySelector('#bkDone')||body.querySelector('.bk-form')));
  }
  function forceOpenBook(){
    var vs=document.getElementById('viewSheet'),body=document.getElementById('vsBody'),title=document.getElementById('vsTitle');
    if(!vs||!body)return false;
    try{
      if(typeof viewBodyHTML!=='function')return false;
      if(title)title.textContent=(typeof LANG!=='undefined'&&LANG==='es')?'Reserva tu evento':'Book Your Event';
      body.innerHTML=viewBodyHTML('book');
      try{curView='book';}catch(e){}
      if(typeof callSheet==='function')body.querySelectorAll('[data-call]').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',callSheet);});
      if(typeof wireBook==='function')wireBook();
      if(typeof openView==='function')body.querySelectorAll('[data-goview]').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){openView(b.dataset.goview);});});
      vs.classList.add('open');vs.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');vs.scrollTop=0;
      if(typeof lockScroll==='function')lockScroll();
      return true;
    }catch(e){return false;}
  }
  function openBookNow(){
    try{if(typeof closeMenu==='function')closeMenu();}catch(e){}
    try{if(typeof openView==='function')openView('book');}catch(e){}
    if(!bookIsOpen())forceOpenBook();
  }
  btn.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    openBookNow();
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ================= JARVIS DIAL — FUNCTION (Taylor's order) ================
   The dial was display-only: no handler existed for the reactor or its
   side labels (verified by source search before this wiring was added).
   Now: tapping a full-word dial label (Inquiries / Events / Messages)
   jumps to that dashboard area — the same open-detail behaviour as the
   At a Glance cards and the All Areas tiles. Tapping the PV core opens
   the EXISTING Dashboard Assistant panel (it clicks the assistant's own
   floating button, so there is no second agent); tapping it again
   closes the panel, exactly like that button. The assistant is a
   prototype: it demos task steps from the dashboard's shown data and
   never sends, books or changes anything for real. */
(function(){
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-dial]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){
      dashArea=b.getAttribute('data-dial');
      renderPills(); renderDetail();
      detail.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'});
    });
  });
  var core=document.getElementById('pvCore');
  function tapCore(){
    var fab=document.getElementById('daFab');
    if(fab)fab.click();
  }
  if(core){
    core.addEventListener('click',tapCore);
    core.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); tapCore(); }
    });
  }
  if(typeof setLang==='function'){
    var _prevDial=setLang;
    setLang=function(l){
      _prevDial(l);
      if(core)core.setAttribute('aria-label',l==='es'?'Hablar con el asistente del panel':'Talk to the dashboard assistant');
    };
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
